item.content:encoded: Leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won Brazil's presidential election, the country's electoral authority said on Sunday, defeating right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in a runoff to secure a fourth non-consecutive term.

item.title: Oilers hope to brush off worst loss of season as Wings pay visit
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers suffered just one regulation loss while winning eight of their first 10 games en route to first place in the Western Conference.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Edmonton Oilers suffered just one regulation loss while winning eight of their first 10 games en route to first place in the Western Conference. There was plenty of reason for optimism for Mike Babcock's squad. Then came the Saturday Night Massacre. Edmonton not only had its three-game winning streak snapped by the visiting Toronto Maple Leafs, it suffered its ugliest loss of the season on Hockey Night in Canada, 7-2. The Oilers will try and bounce back on Monday night when they host the Detroit Red Wings. "It's a shame because, you know, a Saturday night against these guys is what we live for as hockey players, and it just wasn't enough," Oilers right wing Kasperi Kapanen said. "It's a shame. I think we should be really excited to play a game like this (Saturday) and, you know, for whatever reason, we just weren't at our best ... Hopefully, this kind of wakes us up and then we just bring our best on Monday." Leon Draisaitl scored both goals for the Oilers to give him 12 for the season, tied with Minnesota's Kirill Kaprizov for top spot in the NHL. Connor McDavid assisted on both goals to increase his league-leading point total to 33, including an NHL-best 25 assists, in just 11 games. But scoring from the team's bottom six forwards continues to be an issue. "Their bottom six was better than ours, but the bottom line is they were better than us, they were more competitive than us," Babcock said. "They were quicker than us, they were better. We can blame anybody we want. As a group, as a coach, (Toronto coach) Jim Hiller had his group playing harder than I had my group. That's on me." "They were just better than us," left wing Zach Hyman added. "They were more competitive, they won more battles ... they just beat us in every area." Detroit, seventh in the Atlantic Division, will be finishing up a four-game road trip that started with a 4-3 shootout loss at Seattle followed by a 5-2 victory at Vancouver. The Red Wings come in off a 4-1 loss at Calgary on Saturday, the team's first regulation loss in seven games. Andrew Copp scored the lone goal for the Red Wings to tie it 1-1 early in the second period, but the Flames answered with three consecutive goals later in the period to pull away for the easy win. It marked Detroit's first loss to Calgary since March 12, 2022. "I thought it was one of our poorer nights, as far as execution goes," Detroit coach Todd McLellan said. Copp added that the Red Wings "never really got traction" against the Flames. They'll need to find a spark on offense to keep up with the Oilers, whose 4.36 goals per game lead the NHL. Detroit ranks 25th at 2.55 per game. "We had a couple of good shifts, maybe a couple good minutes at a time, but never really kind of fully got control of the game and shift after shift where we were doing all the right things," Copp said. "It wasn't our best night, for sure. We have one more game to salvage the road trip." --Field Level Media

item.title: トランプ氏、カナダ関税紛争「近く解決」と主張 国境州の集会で
item.description:
Valerie Volcovici
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Valerie Volcovici

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２５日、ミシガン州で開いた政治集会で、カナダとの貿易紛争が「近く」解決するとの見通しを示した。詳細には触れなかった。

１１月３日の中間選挙を前に同州ポートヒューロンで開いた集会で、トランプ氏らはカナダが貿易で米国を「食い物にしてきた」とし、関税引き上げが必要だとする従来の主張を繰り返した。

トランプ氏は「そうせざるを得なかった」と述べた上で、「かなり近いうちに決着するだろう。カナダは今、われわれの要求を何でも受け入れる用意がある」と語った。

トランプ氏は２０２４年の大統領選で、ポートヒューロンを含むミシガン州の国境地域で６６％を超える得票率で勝利した。しかし、デトロイトを拠点とする米自動車産業を含め、地域経済は米加間の関税を巡る対立の影響を受けている。

同州の上院選で民主党のアブドゥル・エルサイード候補と接戦を繰り広げる共和党元下院議員のマイク・ロジャーズ候補は、自動車分野に対するトランプ氏の関税政策と距離を置こうとしてきた。

ロジャーズ氏は２５日、トランプ氏の関税がシボレーとデトロイト・ディーゼルによるミシガン州への製造業投資につながったと評価する一方、「カナダに対するこれらの関税のうち、自動車に関する部分には少し懸念がある」と指摘。報道番組「ミート・ザ・プレス」で「良い面もあるが、取り組む必要がある課題もある」と語った。

item.title: Luka Doncic scores 52 as Lakers rally from 18 down to beat Jazz
item.description: Luka Doncic scored 52 points and added 10 assists and eight rebounds to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Luka Doncic scored 52 points and added 10 assists and eight rebounds to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday. Doncic made 8 of 18 3-point attempts as part of 17-of-30 shooting as the Lakers improved to 3-0. It marked the 10th time he scored 50 or more points in a regular-season game. Doncic made several critical baskets late to help the Lakers win for the eighth time in their last nine games against Utah. He finished off a 14-5 go-ahead run with two 3s in a span of 40 seconds that gave Los Angeles a 127-121 lead with 1:42 left. The second trey put him at 50 points. Austin Reaves added 29 points for the Lakers. Doncic and Reaves combined for 21 of 24 from the free-throw line. Walker Kessler tallied only two points and seven rebounds in his first game back in Utah after being sent by the Jazz to Los Angeles in a trade over the summer. Lauri Markkanen scored 28 points to lead Utah, who blew an 18-point second-quarter lead. Keyonte George tallied 24 points, 10 assists and nine rebounds for the Jazz. Jaren Jackson Jr. added 20 points while Ace Bailey chipped in 17 points and 12 rebounds. Bailey made 7 of 8 shots and scored 15 points in the first quarter to help Utah race out to a 47-29 lead by quarter's end. Markkanen added 12 points on 4-of-5 shooting in that stretch, culminating a deep buzzer-beating 3-pointer. George dished out seven first-quarter assists - a career-best. Utah shot 61% from the floor and had 14 assists on 19 baskets in the first quarter. Defensively, the Jazz held the Lakers to 36% shooting from the field in that stretch. Doncic scored 17 of Los Angeles' first 25 points. Reaves made three 3s and tallied 15 points in the second quarter, giving the Lakers a lift on offense. Los Angeles also clamped down on defense, forcing a slew of turnovers, and erased the deficit before halftime. Doncic hit a stepback 3-pointer with 4.7 seconds left in the half to give the Lakers their first lead at 74-71. Doncic added 14 points in the third quarter and Los Angeles took a 103-100 lead into the final stanza. Doncic capped the scoring with two free throws with 12.5 seconds remaining. Los Angeles shot 49.4% from the field for the game, including 20 of 47 from 3-point range. Utah connected on 48.9% of its attempts and made 10 of 35 from behind the arc. The Jazz held a commanding 51-30 rebounding advantage. --Field Level Media

item.title: Wolff hails Antonelli's best race yet after US victory
item.description: Kimi Antonelli has given his Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff nine wins to get excited about this season but the Italian's dominant drive from pole position at Sunday's US Grand Prix took that to another level.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Kimi Antonelli has given his Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff nine wins to get excited about this season but the Italian's dominant drive from pole position at [USN:L6N46B095 TEXT:"Sunday's US Grand Prix"] took that to another level. The 20-year-old, set to become the youngest ever Formula One champion in Mexico next weekend, won by more than 13 seconds on a one-stop strategy. His teammate and closest title rival George Russell, now 123 points behind with 125 still to be won, started sixth and finished eighth -- just enough to keep the championship hanging by a thread. "On Kimi's side the main headline is that for me (that's) the best race that he's delivered so far," Wolff said. "Getting off the start with the inferior tyre and then controlling it (the race) at all times. The race of a champion who isn't the champion yet, but exceptional. "I think he's outperformed the car. His driving style just glues with the car." Wolff, reminded that Antonelli has had some special wins already this season including at his home Italian Grand Prix from the back of the grid as well as Monaco and Spa, accepted that sometimes he struggled to remember past races. "Both of them were pretty good," he said in reference to Monza. "But the headline, this is the best, we can keep." Antonelli was happy to agree with the boss. "I think it was one of the best, because of how we built up during the weekend," he told reporters. "And, you know, it was a great team effort as well today, especially with the strategy, believing in the one-stop. And, yeah, it was a really great team effort, and they all deserve this result today. "Monza, we clearly had the fastest car. We were just super quick, so of course it was incredibly special coming from the back," he added. "But it was also a track where it was relatively easy to overtake, and we were so quick. But definitely, Monza was a super special one, and one that I will remember forever. But, you know, this one probably, in terms of execution, was better ... the way we built the performance throughout the weekend was very good."

item.title: Matthew Stafford, Rams end losing skid by prolonging Raiders' slide
item.description: Matthew Stafford threw for three touchdowns Sunday and the visiting Los Angeles Rams built a 28-3 second-quarter lead to cruise to a 35-21 win over the slumping Las Vegas Raiders.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Matthew Stafford threw for three touchdowns Sunday and the visiting Los Angeles Rams built a 28-3 second-quarter lead to cruise to a 35-21 win over the slumping Las Vegas Raiders. Stafford completed 23 of 29 passes for 195 yards and an interception as Los Angeles (3-4) snapped a two-game losing streak. Kyren Williams (16 rushes, 99 yards) and Blake Corum (17 attempts, 93 yards) each scored a touchdown and contributed to the Rams' 386 yards of offense. Kirk Cousins hit 26 of 44 throws for 295 yards and two touchdowns, but it wasn't enough as Las Vegas (3-4) dropped its fourth straight game. The Raiders managed just 48 yards on 17 carries and abandoned the run for most of the second half. Las Vegas did at least make the game competitive with two quick scores in the first 1:48 of the fourth quarter. Cousins hit Tre Tucker for a 37-yard touchdown to start the quarter and, after Stafford tossed a tipped-ball interception to Nakobe Dean, found Ashton Jeanty on a wheel route for a 15-yard score. However, Los Angeles sealed the outcome with a 70-yard drive that chewed up 6:38. Corum covered the last 4 yards to make it 35-18 with 6:34 remaining. Matt Gay kicked a 36-yard field goal for Las Vegas at the 4:11 mark, but the Rams ran out the clock with their running game. Stafford started the scoring with 6:25 left in the first quarter on the first of two touchdown passes to tight end Davis Allen, a 3-yarder. Gay connected on a 30-yard field goal with 51 seconds remaining to cut the deficit to 7-3. Los Angeles broke it open with three touchdowns in less than nine minutes of the second quarter. Stafford found Allen for a 5-yard scoring strike at the 10:01 mark, followed by an 11-yard touchdown to Puka Nacua. Williams tacked on a 17-yard run with 1:19 on the clock. Gay booted a 27-yarder as time expired to make it 28-6 at halftime. --Field Level Media

item.title: Libya summons US envoy to protest at Trump remarks
item.description: Libya's foreign ministry summoned the US chargé d'affaires on Sunday to protest against rally statements by President Donald Trump it described as "offensive", after he called the North African nation "terror-infested".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Libya's foreign ministry summoned the US chargé d'affaires on Sunday to protest against rally statements by President Donald Trump it described as "offensive", after he called the North African nation "terror-infested". The ministry said it rejected any statements that "undermine the dignity of its people or diminish their standing" At Saturday's rally in Perry, Georgia, Trump said, “(US Senator) Jon Ossoff personally sponsored a bill to bring armies of migrants from terror-infested countries like Libya, Yemen, Haiti, Somalia. Remember what I called them? Shithouse countries," in a reference to remarks made during his first term The US was committed to ties with Libya, Trump said on Truth Social on Sunday night, calling its people "proud, resilient, hospitable, and deserving of peace and prosperity" "We respect the Libyan people and the sacrifices that brave Libyans made fighting ISIS, the common enemy of both our peoples, but Libya cannot remain a corridor for illegal migration, and this must end now," he wrote Libya's rival administrations in the east and west denounced Trump's remarks, rejecting attempts to draw Libya into what they called "electoral debates"

item.title: Rockets look to sweep home-and-home vs. Hawks
item.description: The NBA schedule-makers did not allow the Houston Rockets to ease into this season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The NBA schedule-makers did not allow the Houston Rockets to ease into this season. With their 121-114 road victory over the Atlanta Hawks on Saturday, the Rockets remained unbeaten to start the campaign, winning for the third time in four nights. They had opened their schedule with a home triumph Wednesday over the Dallas Mavericks and a road win against the San Antonio Spurs on Friday in the first game of a back-to-back. The Rockets will host the Hawks to conclude a home-and-home on Monday, emboldened by their strong start. "Guys don't care about the circumstances or who's available," Rockets coach Ime Udoka said. "It's a group that's confident with whoever's out on the court." Guard Reed Sheppard was integral in the victory over the Hawks. He posted 19 points (on 5-of-11 3-point shooting), seven assists, six rebounds and two steals while making a spot start for veteran guard Fred VanVleet, who missed last season following preseason knee surgery and sat out the second game of the back-to-back. Reserve center Steven Adams (calf) also sat against the Hawks, as did veteran guard Marcus Smart (forearm), leaving the Rockets' rotation compromised. However, one of the Rockets' strengths entering this season was their depth, and that quality was on display in Atlanta. Sheppard thrived as a starter, and Bogdan Bogdanovic tallied 11 points in 20 minutes off the bench while helping fill the void of Smart's absence. With three members of their rotation unavailable, the Rockets ably shifted on the fly. "Just stick to what we know," Sheppard said. "We've got the guys to do it. That's the good thing about this team is we've got a lot of guys that can play when people don't play, and just going out there and being aggressive and playing the right way and playing together." Adams was ruled out for Monday, while Smart was deemed questionable and VanVleet did not appear on Houston's injury report. The Hawks also played the second game of a back-to-back, and their shooting woes contributed to the Rockets establishing a 20-point lead that enabled them to withstand a late Atlanta run. The Hawks missed 36 of 49 3-pointers. Point forward Jalen Johnson was outstanding (26 points, 16 assists and nine rebounds), but the backcourt tandem of CJ McCollum (17 points) and Nickeil Alexander-Walker (18) finished 5 of 17 from behind the arc. Yet, despite trailing 111-93 with 5:43 remaining, the Hawks closed to within five points with 36.5 seconds left to play. The Hawks' determined effort almost fueled a remarkable comeback victory. "The biggest takeaway is that we kept playing," Hawks coach Quin Snyder said. "Obviously we need to be better in a lot of facets of the game, but the fact that we weren't making shots and we continued to play and then got back into the game (was encouraging). I think it would have been easy to fold at a certain point, and we didn't do that, which is a good thing. "We've talked consistently about trying to become the best version of ourselves, and these are the types of games that give you the opportunity to do that if you take advantage of it. That's where we are right now, and we play them again (on Monday)." --Field Level Media

item.title: Bo Nix throws, runs for TDs as Broncos extend Cards’ home woes
item.description: Bo Nix threw a touchdown pass and ran 62 yards for another, J.K. Dobbins and R.J. Harvey also scored TDs, and the Denver Broncos beat the Arizona Cardinals 30-16 in Glendale, Ariz., on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Bo Nix threw a touchdown pass and ran 62 yards for another, J.K. Dobbins and R.J. Harvey also scored TDs, and the Denver Broncos beat the Arizona Cardinals 30-16 in Glendale, Ariz., on Sunday. Nix finished 15-for-29 passing for 222 yards and also rushed for 73 yards for Denver (5-2), which has won three in a row and won three of four games against NFC West opponents. Jacoby Brissett finished 27-for-48 passing for 272 yards and a touchdown pass to Trey McBride, who had 10 receptions for 111 yards for Arizona. The Cardinals (2-5) have lost 10 straight home games dating back to Sept. 14, 2025. The Broncos grabbed a 6-0 lead on two field goals from Wil Lutz in the first quarter, one from 48 yards and the other from 43. Arizona benefited from a 26-yard pass interference penalty and Bam Knight's 29-yard run to reach Denver's 11 before settling for Chad Ryland's 30-yard field goal to make it 6-3 early in the second quarter. Ryland added a 26-yard field goal on the Cardinals' next possession. Nix gave the Broncos a 13-6 halftime lead with his 62-yard scramble with 3:43 left in the second quarter, and then extended the lead after Denver forced a punt on the Cardinals' first drive of the second half. The third-year signal-caller hit Harvey with a short pass, and the speedy back raced 52 yards to give Denver a 20-6 lead. Arizona responded with a 68-yard drive, getting inside the Broncos' 10 on another pass interference penalty. Brissett hit McBride with a 7-yard TD pass to make it 20-13 late in the third quarter. It was the Cardinals' first touchdown in seven quarters. The Broncos answered on their next possession on Dobbins' one-yard TD run on the last play of the third quarter, and then the defense stopped Arizona on fourth down on the next drive. Lutz's third field goal, from 31 yards, made 30-13, and Ryland's 41-yard kick made it a two-score game with 6:21 remaining. The Cardinals had a first-and-goal from the 1-yard line in the final minute but couldn't punch it in. The two teams combined for 20 accepted penalties for 173 yards. Denver committed 11 infractions for 114 yards. --Field Level Media

item.title: 豪チャレンジャー、第一ライフ傘下企業の買収案拒否 協議継続へ
item.description: [２６日 ロイター] - オーストラリアの資産運用会社チャレンジャーは２６日、第一ライフグループ傘下企業によるチャレ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
豪チャレンジャー、第一ライフ傘下企業の買収案拒否　協議継続へ 8:55 配信

[２６日 ロイター] - オーストラリアの資産運用会社チャレンジャーは２６日、第一ライフグループ傘下企業によるチャレンジャー株７９％超の取得に向けた予備的な提案について、「株主に推奨できる水準ではない」と表明した。

• 第一ライフグループの豪子会社ＴＡＬダイイチライフ・オーストラリアは今月、１株当たり１１．８０豪ドルでの買収を予備的に提案した。チャレンジャー全体の評価額は７９億４０００万豪ドル（５５億８０００万米ドル）となる。

• チャレンジャーは２６日、取締役会が推奨できる提案に至るかどうかを探るため、ＴＡＬダイイチライフ・オーストラリアと協議する意向を示した。

• 声明で「今回の提案が拘束力のある買収提案につながるか、取引が実現するかは確実ではない」と表明した。

• チャレンジャー株は２３１３ＧＭＴ（日本時間２６日午前８時１３分）までに一時１％下落し、１１．８０豪ドルを付けた。

• 第一ライフグループは、ロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

item.title: サッカー＝ゲンク伊東、シント谷口がゴール ベルギーリーグ
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］ - サッカーのベルギー１部は２５日、各地で試合を行い、ゲンクの伊東純也がホームのスタンダール・リエージュ戦で今季２ゴール目を記録し、２─１の勝利に貢献した。

先発した伊東は前半２６分、ＣＫに飛び込んでＧＫと競り合うと、こぼれたボールを自ら押し込んで先制点を挙げた。

前半に相手に退場者が出た後、後半１９分に追いつかれたゲンクだが、同３１分に再び勝ち越した。伊東は後半４０分までプレーし、チームメートの横山歩夢は同１８分から途中出場した。

小久保玲央ブライアン、畑大雅、高井幸大、谷口彰悟、石渡ネルソン、新川志音が先発したシントトロイデンは、敵地でクラブ・ブリュージュに２─３で敗戦。チームが２点ビハインドで迎えた後半アディショナルタイム２分、ゴール前の高井幸大が競り合ってこぼれたボールを谷口彰悟が頭で詰めて１点差としたが、及ばなかった。

小久保、畑、高井、谷口はフル出場。新川と石渡は後半２３分までプレーし、松澤海斗は同２３分から途中出場した。荒木遼太郎はベンチスタートから出番がなかった。

ハーフナー・ニッキがフル出場したサンジロワーズは、ホームでセルクル・ブリュージュに５─２で快勝。ヘントはホームでアンデルレヒトに４─０で完勝した。

item.title: Datafolha projeta Lula reeleito presidente
item.description: O Datafolha projetou neste domingo que o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) venceu o segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e assumirá um quarto mandato na Presidência da República em 5 de janeiro de 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Datafolha projetou neste domingo que o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) venceu o segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e assumirá um quarto mandato na Presidência da República em 5 de janeiro de 2027. De acordo com a apuração oficial do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), com 75,24% das seções apuradas, Lula tinha 51,09% dos votos válidos e Flávio somava 48,91%. (Reportagem de Eduardo Simões e Fernando Cardoso; Edição de Pedro Fonseca)

item.title: 「キューバ変革望む人々はＣＩＡと協力を」、ルビオ氏が呼びかけ
item.description:
Bo Erickson Kanishka Singh
[フォートマイヤーズ（米フロリダ州） ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Kanishka Singh

[フォートマイヤーズ（米フロリダ州） ２３日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は２３日、キューバの変革を望む人々に米中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）との協力を呼びかけた。Ｘに「キューバに前向きな変化をもたらそうとする人々に告ぐ。今こそ、その時だ」と投稿した。

ルビオ氏は、キューバ政府に失望している人々に対し「ＣＩＡとの秘密裏の協力を通じて、望む変化を実現するこの機会をつかんでほしい」と訴えたが、それ以上の説明はしなかった。

一方、トランプ大統領はフロリダ州での集会で「イランへの対応を終えたら、次はキューバに対処する。その後、合意をまとめるためマルコ・ルビオを送り込む」と語った。

トランプ政権はこれまでも、キューバ共産主義政権の変革が目標だと表明しており、米軍が１月にベネズエラ大統領のマドゥロ氏を拘束して以降、キューバ政府への圧力を強めている。年初から実施している石油封鎖はキューバに深刻な打撃を与えており、燃料不足や停電に直面していることに加え、インフラの機能不全が状況を悪化させている。

こうした中、キューバの外相は９月の国連総会で、米政府との対話に常に応じる用意があると述べた。一方、国連の人権専門家らはキューバに対する石油封鎖は国際法違反だと非難している。

item.title: Lions snap Packers' winning streak with Jake Bates' walk-off field goal
item.description: Jake Bates kicked a 22-yard field goal as time expired to give the host Detroit Lions a 20-17 victory over the Green Bay Packers on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jake Bates kicked a 22-yard field goal as time expired to give the host Detroit Lions a 20-17 victory over the Green Bay Packers on Sunday. Jared Goff passed for 303 yards and two touchdowns, both to Jameson Williams. Amon-Ra St. Brown caught nine passes for 153 yards and Williams hauled in five for 91 yards. Jahmyr Gibbs rushed for 116 yards on 29 carries for Detroit (4-2). Jordan Love passed for 274 yards, two touchdowns and one interception for Green Bay (4-3), which had its three-game winning streak snapped. Running back Josh Jacobs, activated off the NFL's exempt list, rushed for 36 yards and caught five passes for 55 yards and a touchdown in his season debut. The Lions drove 71 yards -- highlighted by an 18-yard catch by Sam LaPorta and a 15-yard run by Gibbs along with a key first-down pickup by Gibbs in the final minute -- to set up Bates' game-winning kick against their NFC North rivals. Detroit led 10-7 at halftime. Green Bay came up empty during the game's opening drive as Trey Smack missed a 26-yard field-goal attempt wide right. The Lions needed only six plays to drive 80 yards for their first score, a 16-yard scoring pass from Goff to Williams. The Packers answered with a 12-play, 74-yard drive that Love finished with a 14-yard strike to tight end Tucker Kraft. Bates' 40-yard field goal with 12:36 remaining in the half gave the Lions a 10-7 lead. Detroit drove 85 yards late in the half, but Gibbs lost a fumble on the Packers' 8-yard line. A Goff fumble on the second play from scrimmage in the third quarter allowed the Packers to take their only lead. Green Bay cashed in with a 25-yard pass from Love to Jacobs to gain a 14-10 advantage. The Lions regained the lead on their next possession as Goff capped an 80-yard march with a 10-yard pass over the middle to Williams. Lions coach Dan Campbell lost a gamble after his team drove inside the Packers' 10. Campbell went for it on fourth-and-5 from the 6, but Goff threw an incompletion intended for Williams. Smack's 43-yard field goal with 7:10 left tied the score at 17-17. The Lions gambled and lost again on their next drive. On fourth-and-1 from their own 24, Gibbs was tackled for a 2-yard loss by Keisean Nixon. The Detroit defense held, then D.J. Wonnum got a fingertip on Smack's 35-yard field-goal attempt to send it wide right with 3:21 to play. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ｆ１＝米国ＧＰ、アントネッリが制覇 個人総合優勝は持ち越し
item.description: ［オースティン（米テキサス州） ２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［オースティン（米テキサス州）　２５日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の今季第１８戦、米国グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２５日、米テキサス州オースティンで決勝を行い、メルセデスのキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア）が今季９勝目を挙げた。史上最年少の２０歳での個人総合優勝は次戦のメキシコＧＰに持ち越された。

アントネッリはポールポジションから好スタートを切り、１回のタイヤ交換で走り切って圧勝。２位には１３秒０７８差でシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ、フェラーリ）、３位にはマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）が入った。

アントネッリは個人総合争いで２位のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）との差を１２３点、３位のルイス・ハミルトン（英国、フェラーリ）との差を１２４点に広げた。今季残りの最大獲得可能ポイントは１２５点で、次戦のメキシコＧＰで９位以内に入れば年間王座が確定する。

アントネッリは「私たちに必要な結果だったし、チーム全員がこの結果にふさわしい。王座獲得が非常に近いことは分かっている。最高の形でシーズンを締めくくりたいし、できれば近いうちに決めたい」と語った。

item.title: Trump says Canada tariff deal coming 'soon' at Michigan border rally
item.description: President Donald Trump at a Sunday political rally predicted a trade dispute with Canada would be resolved "soon," without providing specifics.
item.dc:creator: Valerie Volcovici
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump at a Sunday political rally predicted a trade dispute with Canada would be resolved "soon," without providing specifics. At an event in Port Huron, Michigan, to boost Republican candidates ahead of the November 3 midterms, Trump and other speakers reiterated his oft-expressed position that higher tariffs on Canadian goods are needed because Canada "has been ripping off" the US in trade. "I had to do it," Trump told the Michigan crowd. "We'll have that settled pretty soon. They're willing to give us anything at this moment." The office of Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Trump won in Michigan's border region that includes Port Huron in the 2024 presidential election with more than 66% of the vote, but the local economy has felt the impacts of the US-Canada tariff standoff, including the Detroit-based US auto industry. Republican Congressman Mike Rogers, who is running in a tight race against Democratic rival Abdul El-Sayed, has tried to distance himself from the president's tariff policy on the auto sector. Rogers on Sunday hailed Trump's tariffs for securing manufacturing investments for Michigan by Chevrolet and Detroit Diesel, but said "the automobile portion of these Canadian tariffs worries me a little bit." "There's some good and there's some things we have to work on," he told "Meet the Press."

item.title: ゴルフ＝吉田が4打差逆転で米ツアー初優勝、ＢＭＷ女子選手権
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのＢＭＷ女子選手権は２５日、韓国南西部・海南のパインビーチ・リンクス（パー７２）で最終ラウンドを行い、吉田優利が通算１７アンダーの２７１で米ツアー初優勝を飾った。

首位と４打差の２位からスタートした吉田は、２番でイーグルを奪うと、５番から３連続バーディーをマーク。１５番でボギーをたたいたが、１７番ではバンカーからの好ショットでバーディーを奪った。最終１８番はボギーとしたものの、１イーグル、４バーディー、２ボギーの６８で回り、逆転優勝を果たした。

今季日本勢では４人目のツアー優勝者となった吉田は「特別な瞬間。実は緊張していたが、今は本当にうれしい」とコメント。１７番のバンカーショットについては「実は自信がなかった。でも、『とにかく打とう、打とう。距離はぴったりだ』と思った。結果は完璧だった」と振り返った。

前日１９位の畑岡奈紗は６６をマークし、通算１４アンダーの６位に浮上した。岩井姉妹はともに通算１１アンダーの１５位。岩井千怜は６７、岩井明愛は６９で回った。原英莉花は４１位、竹田麗央は４９位、勝みなみと古江彩佳は７４位だった。

item.title: ＡＩ「クロード」、米ジョージア州の票集計データにアクセス 課金回避
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - アンソロピックは２５日の声明で、同社の人工知能（ＡＩ）モデル「クロード」が人間の許可を得ず...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ「クロード」、米ジョージア州の票集計データにアクセス　課金回避 8:49 配信

写真はクロードのロゴとキーボードのイメージ。10月19日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２５日 ロイター] - アンソロピックは２５日の声明で、同社の人工知能（ＡＩ）モデル「クロード」が人間の許可を得ずに課金の仕組みを回避し、米ジョージア州の一般公開されている得票数の集計データにアクセスしたと明らかにした。

• アンソロピックは「クロードは州の有権者登録システムにはアクセスしておらず、投票記録の変更や取得も行っていない」と表明。こうした行動を防ぐ措置を講じたと説明した。

• アンソロピックは今月、クロードが「トークンや料金によってアクセスが制限されたデータにアクセスするため制限を回避」した事例を確認したと明らかにしており、一部の事例には米国の連邦、州、地方の政府機関が運営するウェブサイトが関係していた。

• ジョージア州務長官室のコメントは得られていない。

• クロードによる無許可の行動は、米ニュースサイトのアクシオスが最初に報じた。

item.title: 熊谷ＧＭＯ代表、顧客の損失は補償と表明 サイバー攻撃で
item.description:
Shinichi Uchida Noriyuki Hirata
［東京 ２６日 ロイター］ - ２６日の東京株式市場で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＧＭＯインターネットＧ株が急落、サイバー攻撃の損失補償と社長表明 8:47 配信

写真は「サイバー攻撃」の文字イメージ。10月22日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Shinichi Uchida　Noriyuki Hirata

［東京　２６日　ロイター］ - ２６日の東京株式市場で、ＧＭＯインターネットグループ株が急落した。ＦＸ（外国為替証拠金取引）自動売買サービスにサイバー攻撃があったことを受け、全ての顧客に見舞金５０００円を一律支払うほか、顧客が意図しない不正取引で生じた損失を補償する方針を打ち出したことで、業績への影響に対する不透明感を嫌気した売りが先行している。

熊谷正寿代表は２５日、不正アクセスにより生じた顧客の損失はＧＭＯインターネットが確認した上で補償すると自身のブログで表明した。取引所が返金に応じない場合でも、対象となる損失の全額を支払うとしている。同社によると、一部のユーザーから身に覚えのない取引が行われたとの報告が寄せられているという。

熊谷氏は、顧客の資産や情報を危険にさらす事態を招いた事実を「極めて重く受け止めている」とし、一律５０００円の見舞金は「初動の誠意の印」と説明。財務への影響などは見通しが立ち次第報告するとした。セキュリティーの課題が事前に現場へ指摘され対策を進めながらも、 対応の深さとスピードが十分ではなく、その間隙を突かれたとした。また、人工知能（ＡＩ）技術の進化に伴い攻撃者のコストが劇的に低下し、脅威が急速に深刻化しているとも訴えた。

ＧＭＯによると、攻撃者とみられる相手から金銭を要求されており、応じなければ自社や顧客の情報を公開するとの連絡も受けているという。要求には応じない方針で、警察などと連携して対応するとしている。２４日には、先制的に相手を無力化する「能動的サイバー防御」の適用を政府に緊急要請したことも発表した。

ＧＭＯは今月１９日、顧客からの問い合わせを受けて調査を開始した。２０日にサービスの一部顧客のサーバー環境への不正なプログラムの設置を確認し、２１日には被害拡大防止のため全プランのサーバーを順次停止した。顧客から取引口座での身に覚えのない操作などの報告があり、２２日に警察へ相談した。

item.title: Lula lidera apuração do 2º turno com 50,55% contra 49,45% de Flávio, com 60,85% das seções eleitorais apuradas, diz TSE
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) liderava a apuração do segundo turno da eleição presidencial deste domingo com 50,55% dos votos válidos, enquanto o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) somava 49,45%, com 60,85% das seções eleitorais apuradas, mostraram dados do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) liderava a apuração do segundo turno da eleição presidencial deste domingo com 50,55% dos votos válidos, enquanto o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) somava 49,45%, com 60,85% das seções eleitorais apuradas, mostraram dados do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE). O horário de votação, inicialmente previsto para encerrar às 17h, foi ampliado em duas horas por decisão do ministro Cristiano Zanin, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), após pedidos das duas campanhas que alegaram problemas com transporte público e causados pelas chuvas em algumas cidades. (Reportagem de Eduardo Simões e Fernando Cardoso; Edição de Alexandre Caverni)

item.title: China's tug-of-war with Australian miners lurks beneath iron ore calm
item.description: If China's iron ore market was to be judged by import volumes alone, the image would be one of gentle and steady growth.
item.dc:creator: Clyde Russell
item.content:encoded: If China's iron ore market was to be judged by import volumes alone, the image would be one of gentle and steady growth. But beneath the calm picture presented by imports of the main steel raw material is a tug-of-war between China, which buys about 75% of global seaborne supplies, and Australia's miners, which provide around two-thirds of China's needs. Beijing is attempting to gain more control of iron ore pricing, seeking to leverage its buying power to secure favourable terms. The problem is that Australian miners such as Rio Tinto (RIO.AX) (RIO.L) , BHP Group (BHP.AX) and Fortescue (FMG.AX) have considerable market power of their own as China has no alternative sources that supply the volume of required iron ore. China's imports of iron ore were 109.82 million metric tons in September, up 1.2% from August, while arrivals for the first nine months of 2026 were 954.97 million tons, an increase of 4.1%, according to customs data. October imports are likely to be similar to those for September with analysts DBX Commodities tracking seaborne arrivals of 105.7 million tons. China also buys small volumes overland from neighbouring countries. The modest gain in iron ore imports so far in 2026 comes despite weakness in the steel sector, which is suffering from weak profitability and declining production amid ongoing weakness in the key housing construction sector. Rather than being used to lift steel production, the gain in iron ore imports has largely flowed to rebuilding stockpiles. Port inventories monitored by consultants SteelHome were assessed at 152.23 million tons in the week to October 23, up 14% from 133.6 million in the same week in 2025. Lower prices in recent weeks have boosted import appetite, with Singapore Exchange contracts ending at $90.60 on October 23, down 19% from the $111.91 peak so far this year on May 11. CHINA MOVES The drift lower in iron ore prices also comes amid efforts by China's state-controlled buyer, China Mineral Resources Group (CMRG), which functions as an intermediary between iron ore miners and steel mills. In practical terms this has resulted in CMRG imposing a series of measures at various times against the Australian miners, in what are viewed by market participants as attempts to exert greater control over prices and supply contracts. CMRG reached a [USN:L1N4670LW TEXT:"supply deal"] with Rio Tinto, the world's largest iron ore miner, last week, according to people with knowledge of the matter, although details of the agreement were not immediately known. The deal came after CMRG instructed some steel mills in August to halt talks with Rio for September-loading cargoes. CMRG is still in dispute with Fortescue, with the company flagging on October 22 that if [USN:FWN467211 TEXT:"talks"] aren't concluded by the end of the year, operations may be affected. A similar dispute in which CMRG restricted purchases from BHP was resolved in April, and while terms weren't disclosed, it is believed the miner agreed to use several pricing indexes and accept small discounts. Overall, it would appear that CMRG is having some small success in extracting better terms from the Australian miners. However, China remains highly dependent on Australia for iron ore, and will remain so for years to come even as it seeks to diversify suppliers, with the ramp-up of the 120-million-tons-a-year Simandou project in Guinea being the primary example. It's also likely that iron ore prices will be driven mainly by the steel sector, and the decline in recent months tallies with lower steel production, which was down 2.9% in the first nine months of the year to 724.77 million tons. Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI) , your essential new source for global financial commentary. ROI delivers thought-provoking, data-driven analysis of everything from swap rates to soybeans. Markets are moving faster than ever. ROI can help you keep up. Follow ROI on LinkedIn and X . The views expressed here are those of the author, a columnist for Reuters.

item.title: ウクライナ和平協議、欧州を含めるべき＝ロシア大統領補佐官
item.description: [モスクワ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ ２５日 ロイター] - ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官は２５日の国営テレビのインタビューで、ウクライナ和平合意に向けた協議には欧州を含めるべきだとの考えを示した。欧州の立場が和平実現の鍵を握る可能性があるためだとしている。

ウシャコフ氏は米国がウクライナに和平合意受け入れを迫ることができていないと指摘。２０２５年に米アラスカ州アンカレッジで行われたトランプ米大統領とプーチン大統領の会談に言及して「アンカレッジ会談後は、米政権が何らかの要求を突き付け、ウクライナに従わせることができるようにも見えた。しかし、これまでのところ実現していない」と述べた。

さらにその理由について「ウクライナと話をするだけでは十分ではなく、ウクライナを全面的に支援している欧州全体と対話する必要があるためだ」と語った。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）は当初、戦争終結に向けた仲介をトランプ氏に委ねていたが、その後はロシアへの慎重な働きかけを行っている。英国、ドイツ、フランスの首脳も、停戦実現に向けてウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領とプーチン氏による協議案を支持し、欧州も役割を果たす考えだ。

ウシャコフ氏はまた、ロシアが１１月４日の「国民統一の日」以降、ウクライナと米国を交えた３者による和平協議を再開する用意があると表明した。

ゼレンスキー氏は２３日にウクライナ、ロシア、米国の和平交渉担当者が１１月前半にアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビで実務者協議を行うことで合意したと明らかにし、その後に首脳会談が実現することに期待を表していた。

ウシャコフ氏はプーチン氏、中国の習近平国家主席、トランプ氏による会談の可能性についても準備が既に始まっていると説明した。会談は１１月１８－１９日に中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせて行われる予定だという。

item.title: Mourinho gives Real Madrid the answers to Barcelona test in return to Clasico
item.description: Real Madrid recorded just a second victory in eight games against Barcelona on Sunday night, with the return of Jose Mourinho to the fixture haunting the reigning champions.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: Real Madrid recorded just a second victory in eight games against Barcelona on Sunday night, with the return of Jose Mourinho to the fixture haunting the reigning champions. In the first Clasico of Mourinho's first spell at Real Madrid, Barcelona ripped his side to shreds in a 5-0 win at Camp Nou. A [USN:L6N46B08P TEXT:"2-1 win"] in the first Clasico of his second spell suggests Mourinho's Real Madrid can challenge Barcelona's recent LaLiga dominance in his first season back in Spain. Although the chances were shared out evenly, with Barcelona racking up more shots on goal, more possession and more passes throughout the match, those statistics were not an honest reflection of the game. Real Madrid played as if they had the answers to the test Barcelona posed. "The lads played an extraordinary match," said Mourinho in his press conference afterwards. "Very organised, focused, and showing the courage to play the ball out from the back against an opponent that applied a lot of pressure." Time and again, Mourinho's side moved the ball with urgency and precision in their own half to escape Barcelona's pressing. Fede Valverde was praised for playing through injury by Mourinho, but above all he embodied the presence of mind to identify where the space was whenever the ball was turned over. The Uruguayan did so from the right-back position, despite stating in September 2025 that he was "not born to play as a full-back." Valverde later denied he had expressed any unwillingness to play in defence, but a number of Spanish outlets took this as a suggestion he was not pleased about doing so, and perhaps he was not on board with then-manager Xabi Alonso's style of management. For a third game in a row, the Real Madrid captain started at right-back and delivered a captain's performance. Valverde's impressive showing in his unfavoured position demonstrated Mourinho not only is finding tactical solutions to get the best out of his players, but is winning over the Real Madrid dressing room. Mourinho remarked that leaving Camp Nou just three points behind Barcelona "gives us peace of mind, and it's well deserved." The victory over Barcelona should help to boost morale and build unity within the Real Madrid squad. More importantly, Mourinho now has evidence his methods can help return Real Madrid to the summit of Spanish football. "If we win today but lose at El Sardinero, it counts for nothing, because Madrid isn't playing to win at the Camp Nou," Mourinho said. "They’re playing to win the championship" — a statement that now looks closer to reality after two defeats in September had sown early doubts about Mourinho's plans.

item.title: 76ers will rest Joel Embiid (foot) vs. Pistons
item.description: After recording his 11th career triple-double on Saturday versus the Milwaukee Bucks, Philadelphia 76ers center Joel Embiid has been ruled out of Sunday's game against the Detroit Pistons to manage his workload. due to right foot plantar fasciitis management.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: After recording his 11th career triple-double on Saturday versus the Milwaukee Bucks, Philadelphia 76ers center Joel Embiid has been ruled out of Sunday's game against the Detroit Pistons to manage his workload. due to right foot plantar fasciitis management. The oft-injured Embiid, who deals with plantar fasciitis in his right foot, told reporters after the 127-116 win over Milwaukee that he wanted to play against Detroit. "I actually want to play tomorrow, so can you guys put pressure on them," Embiid said. "... I want to play tomorrow, so start writing articles and put pressure on them so they'll let me play." But with LeBron James returning to the lineup versus the Pistons, the Sixers opted to stick with the plan to rest Embiid. James did not play (sciatica) against the Bucks. Embiid played 36 minutes on Saturday and amassed 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists as Philadelphia moved to 3-0. He leads the Sixers with 9.7 rebounds per game while ranking second in assists (5.7 apg) and third in scoring (21.7 ppg). James may have to play minutes at the center position as 76ers bigs Dominick Barlow (back), Jabari Walker (knee) and Tacko Fall (quad) are all on the shelf. Veteran Dean Wade, who scored seven points and added two rebounds and three steals in his Philadelphia debut on Saturday, and Adem Bona will also likely see time at center. --Field Level Media

item.title: 原油先物、半年ぶり高値から反落 サウジ攻撃で供給懸念は継続
item.description: [北京 ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京 ２６日 ロイター] - ２６日アジア時間の原油先物は１ドル超下落し、先週末に付けた約６カ月ぶりの高値から反落している。ただ、サウジアラビアへの攻撃が続く中、供給懸念は根強い。

００１８ＧＭＴ（日本時間午前９時１８分）時点で、米ＷＴＩ先物は１．６０ドル（１．５５％）安の１バレル＝１０１．６７ドル。北海ブレント先物は１．５６ドル（１．３４％）安の１１５．１６ドル。

２３日はイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジへの攻撃でエネルギー供給への懸念が強まり、清算値が３ドル近く上昇。週間ではブレントが６％、ＷＴＩが２．３％上昇していた。

攻撃は週末も続き、フーシ派は２４日にサウジの空港や石油施設を攻撃したと発表。サウジは２５日、複数のミサイルとドローン（無人機）を迎撃したと表明した。

item.title: フィギュア＝三浦が2位、ＳＰ9位から巻き返す ＧＰフランス大会
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第１戦、フランス大会は２５日、男子フリーを行い、ショートプログラム（ＳＰ）９位の三浦佳生が１７５．２９点をマークし、合計２４７．９６点で２位に入った。

三浦は冒頭の４回転サルコーを成功させた後、４回転トーループで転倒したが、演技後半の４回転トーループと３回転トーループの連続ジャンプなどを決め、フリー２位の得点で巻き返した。

ＳＰ８位の山本草太は４回転トーループなどを決め、フリー４位の１４７．２２点、合計２２４．２４点で５位に順位を上げた。

アダム・シアオイムファ（フランス）がＳＰ、フリーともに首位の合計２８４．２４点で優勝した。

item.title: 暗号資産で制裁回避、ネタニヤフ氏の構想に批判 総選挙控え
item.description:
Steven Scheer
[エルサレム ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Steven Scheer

[エルサレム ２５日 ロイター] - 今週の総選挙で再選を目指すイスラエルのネタニヤフ首相が、国際的な制裁が科された場合に暗号資産（仮想通貨）を活用して経済を守る構想を示し、経済学者や政敵から批判を浴びている。

ネタニヤフ氏は２３日、イスラエルのテレビ局チャンネル１０のインタビューで、同国に対する制裁が拡大する事態に備えていると述べた。

英国、フランス、カナダは９月、ヨルダン川西岸のイスラエル入植地からの輸入を禁止すると表明。一部の伝統的な同盟国との間で外交的孤立が深まっていることが浮き彫りになった。

ネタニヤフ氏は「制裁が科される可能性があり、銀行も対象になり得るため、制裁を回避できる経済の仕組みを構築する必要がある」とし、「（制裁を）回避できる通貨がある。われわれはその取り組みも進めている」と述べた。

暗号資産を指しているのかと問われると「その通りだ」と答え、ブロックチェーン技術も選択肢に挙げた。

この発言に対し、イスラエル中央銀行は異例の非難を表明。暗号資産は制裁を回避する手段にはなり得ず、政治指導者はそうした措置を不要にする政策に注力すべきだとした。

「イスラエル経済にとって正しい道は、主要貿易相手との経済関係を維持し、制裁とそれが経済に及ぼす悪影響を防ぐことに注力することだ」と強調した。

ネタニヤフ氏は２５日も自身の実績を擁護し、有権者に支持を呼びかけるとともに、イランの支配体制打倒に向け、トランプ米大統領と協力できる時間はあと２年あると述べた。

＜構想に批判＞

イスラエル中銀の元当局者や複数のノーベル賞受賞者を含む１００人超の経済学者は２５日、ネタニヤフ氏の提案に警鐘を鳴らす書簡に署名した。同氏の構想が失業の増加、海外からの投資減少、世界におけるイスラエルの経済的地位の崩壊につながると指摘した。

２７日の選挙でネタニヤフ氏の最大の対抗馬となるガディ・アイゼンコット氏は、暗号資産構想を「狂気の沙汰」と批判。「ビビコイン政策」が企業の国外流出を招き、国家安全保障を損なう恐れがあると述べた。

野党党首のラピド前首相は「ネタニヤフ氏は常軌を逸している」とした上で、「彼はこの選挙を前に、イスラエル国民に対し、ロシアやイランのようにパンを求めて１時間半も列に並ぶことになると約束している」と述べた。

世論調査では、今回の選挙でネタニヤフ氏率いる与党連合も野党連合も議会の過半数を確保できず、膠着状態に陥る可能性が示されている。

item.title: 脆弱性発見のＰＨＰ、支援財団常勤スタッフは1人だけ＝代表
item.description:
Toby Sterling
[アムステルダム ２３日 ロイター] - ２つの重大な脆弱性が見つかったプログラミング言語...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
脆弱性発見のＰＨＰ、支援財団常勤スタッフは1人だけ＝代表 8:27 配信

写真は「PHPコード」のイメージ。10月22日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Toby Sterling

[アムステルダム ２３日 ロイター] - ２つの重大な脆弱性が見つかったプログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」を支援し、世界中のウェブサイトの最大７割で利用されているとされる非営利団体（ＮＰＯ）「ＰＨＰ財団」のエリザベス・バロン事務局長は２３日、同財団がごくわずかな予算で運営されているとメールでの取材に答えた。

バロン氏は「常勤スタッフは（私のみの）１人で、残りの１４人は主にパートタイムの契約社員」だと回答した。理事は無報酬のボランティアであり、資金は寄付や助成金によって賄われている。

同財団は米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業のオープンＡＩや、ともにサイバーセキュリティーの新興企業Ｗｉｚ（ウィズ）、カリフなどの企業や外部の研究者と連携し、セキュリティー上の欠陥を調査するとともに、２１日に公開したパッチを含めた修正作業に当たっている。

セキュリティー企業クラウドフレアは数百万件のハッキングがあったと報告した。だがバロン氏は、脆弱性が公表される前や、パッチが適用されたサイトでハッカーが情報を盗み出した証拠は把握していないと説明。「この問題について緊密に連携しているオープンＡＩ、ウィズ、カリフのいずれからも、パッチが適用されたシステムに関して問題の報告は受けていない」と答えた。

ＰＨＰ財団にとってＡＩはもろ刃の剣となっている。ＡＩは１０年間も続いていた欠陥を発見するのを助け、バロン氏はプログラマーの作業効率も向上させたと紹介した。

メンテナンスの作業負荷も増大させている。同財団には１年前の２倍弱のコード変更提案が寄せられているが、「貢献者の数は２倍にはなっていない」と指摘。貢献内容やバグの報告の審査には「膨大な人的リソースと経験」が必要となると解説した。

バロン氏は、２つの脆弱性が見つかったことに伴う混乱は企業や政府がいかにＰＨＰ財団に依存しているのかを浮き彫りにしたとして「その依存度を考えると、ＰＨＰへの資金提供が著しく不足していることは明らかだ」と訴えた。

item.title: Flávio tem 50,20% dos votos contra 49,80% de Lula, com 40,23% das seções eleitorais apuradas, diz TSE
item.description: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) liderava a apuração do segundo turno da eleição presidencial neste domingo com 50,20% dos votos válidos, enquanto o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) somava 49,80%, com 40,23% das seções eleitorais apuradas, segundo dados do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE).

item.content:encoded: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) liderava a apuração do segundo turno da eleição presidencial neste domingo com 50,20% dos votos válidos, enquanto o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) somava 49,80%, com 40,23% das seções eleitorais apuradas, segundo dados do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE). item.title: Oil slips from near six-months highs despite supply concerns
item.description: Oil prices fell on Monday after surging to near six-month highs late last week, although ongoing attacks on Saudi Arabia kept supply concerns in focus.
item.dc:creator: Colleen Howe
item.content:encoded: Oil prices fell on Monday after surging to near six-month highs late last week, although ongoing attacks on Saudi Arabia kept supply concerns in focus. US crude futures were down $1.60, or 1.55%, at $101.67 per barrel by 0018 GMT. Brent crude futures were down $1.56 or 1.34% at $115.16. Prices had [USN:L1N46903W TEXT:"settled"] nearly $3 higher on Friday after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked energy supply concerns. Brent finished the week up 6% and WTI ended 2.3% higher. Attacks continued over the weekend with Houthis saying they had attacked the Saudi airport and oil facilities on Saturday. Saudi Arabia said on Sunday it had intercepted more missiles and drones. The top oil exporter [USN:L2N46A05D TEXT:"restarted"] partial operations at its main airport on Sunday after damage in a previous round of Houthi attacks even as the militant group vowed to keep targeting the facility.

item.title: CEO da AtlasIntel projeta à Reuters vitória de Lula no 2º turno da eleição presidencial
item.description: O CEO da AtlasIntel, Andrei Roman, projetou em entrevista à Reuters neste domingo a reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) no segundo turno da eleição presidencial deste domingo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O CEO da AtlasIntel, Andrei Roman, projetou em entrevista à Reuters neste domingo a reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) no segundo turno da eleição presidencial deste domingo. Roman citou à Reuters a redução da abstenção neste segundo turno como um dos fatores que, segundo ele, levará à vitória de Lula sobre o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Com 35,08% das seções apuradas, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) liderava a disputa pelo Palácio do Planalto com 50,30% dos votos válidos, ante 49,70% de Lula. O percentual de abstenção estava em 19,25%. No primeiro turno, a abstenção foi de 21,08%.

item.title: 独首相が連立政権の結束訴え、過激勢力台頭やロシア工作に危機感
item.description: [ベルリン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ベルリン ２４日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は２４日、連立政権内の結束を呼びかけるとともに、政治的過激派の台頭や、ロシアによる日常的な不安定化工作が強まっているとして危機感をにじませた。

メルツ氏は、保守系与党キリスト教民主同盟（ＣＤＵ）の姉妹政党キリスト教社会同盟（ＣＳＵ）の党大会における演説で、ドイツは「極めて深刻な課題」に直面していると指摘。「国内の過激派勢力や国外勢力による脅威が増す中で、欧州における自由と安全をどのように守るのかが問われている」と強調するとともに、ロシアが「日々ドイツの不安定化を図っている」と非難した。

ドイツとロシアの関係は、ロシアによる２０２２年のウクライナ侵攻以降、冷戦終結後で最悪の水準に落ち込んだ。ロシア側は、ドイツや他の欧州諸国に対するハイブリッド攻撃を展開しているとの指摘を否定している。

先に行われたドイツ東部の州選挙で与党陣営が大敗。極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」が２州で第１党となり、首都ベルリンでは左派党が最多得票を獲得した。

こうした結果を受けてメルツ氏の支持率は過去最低水準に低下し、連立相手の社会民主党（ＳＰＤ）とだけでなく、統一会派を組むＣＤＵとＣＳＵの間でもあつれきが表面化している。

党大会では、メルツ氏が連邦政府に参加するＣＳＵ所属閣僚や、ＣＳＵ党首のマルクス・ゼーダー氏を評価した。また来年退任予定のシュタインマイヤー大統領の後任候補としてＣＳＵが推すイルゼ・アイグナー氏にメルツ氏が言及すると、参加者から大きな拍手が起きた。ただＣＤＵはこれまでアイグナー氏への支持表明を見送っており、関係者の話では、独自候補擁立の可能性もなお残しているという。

一方でメルツ氏は、世論調査で首位に立つＡｆＤとの協力を模索すべきだとの保守派内の一部意見については改めて否定して「ＡｆＤと共に投票する政治家に、わが陣営の居場所はない」と述べた。

さらにＳＰＤと緑の党に対し、ベルリンで左派党との連立政権を組まないよう求めた。メルツ氏は左派党が党内の反ユダヤ主義を容認していると批判したが、左派党側は組織的な反ユダヤ主義の存在を否定している。

item.title: Raptors F Kawhi Leonard (knee) out vs. Timbwerwolves
item.description: Toronto Raptors star forward Kawhi Leonard was scratched with left knee swelling about an hour before the team's Sunday night road game against the Minnesota Timberwolves.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Toronto Raptors star forward Kawhi Leonard was scratched with left knee swelling about an hour before the team's Sunday night road game against the Minnesota Timberwolves. Leonard has often experienced issues with both knees throughout his 15-year career. This is his first missed game since returning to the Raptors, whom he led to the 2019 NBA title. Leonard missed the 2021-22 season for the Los Angeles Clippers due to an ACL tear in his right knee. Leonard was acquired in the offseason from the Clippers. He is a seven-time All-Star and two-time NBA Finals MVP (once with Toronto, once with the San Antonio Spurs). The 35-year-old Leonard averaged 19.5 points, 7.5 rebounds and 3.5 steals as Toronto won its first two games of the season. However, he shot just 32.4% from the field and made 4 of 14 3-point attempts. --Field Level Media

item.title: Reactions to election victory of Serbia's Student List
item.description: Serbia's Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat to a student-led protest movement in a historic election on Sunday that ends his long grip on power and heralds a new political era in the Balkan country.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Serbia's Aleksandar Vucic [USN:L6N46B017 TEXT:"conceded defeat"] to a student-led protest movement in a historic election on Sunday that ends his long grip on power and heralds a new political era in the Balkan country. Below are reactions to the students' victory: MILORAD DODIK, BOSNIAN SERB SEPARATIST AND PRO-RUSSIAN LEADER OF THE ALLIANCE OF INDEPENDENT SOCIAL DEMOCRATS "I congratulate the Student List on its victory. The citizens of Serbia and all political actors have once again demonstrated the democratic character of one of the oldest state-building nations in Europe." "Republika Srpska and Serbia continue forward together. The closest and in the best of relations. In cooperation and support on all issues — regional and international, at every forum and in every institution." "The voice of the people is the voice of God. The citizens of Republika Srpska and Serbia have spoken. We move forward — together," Dodik wrote on X. EUROPEAN COMMISSIONER FOR ENLARGEMENT, MARTA KOS "Serbia has raised its voice. After nearly two years of protests for democracy, the rule of law and the fight against corruption, the citizens of Serbia turned out to vote in historic numbers," Kos wrote in a statement to Slovenian correspondents from Brussels. URSULA VON DER LEYEN, HEAD OF THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION "Today, the people of Serbia turned out in record numbers to shape their country’s future. Congratulations to the Student List on its victory in the parliamentary elections. We stand ready to support reforms on the rule of law, media freedom, the fight against corruption and strong democratic institutions, and to work together to advance Serbia’s future in the European Union," von der Leyen wrote on X social media platform. SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE COUNCIL OF EUROPE ALAIN BERSET "Congratulations to the Student List of Serbia on your electoral result. Serbian citizens have made their democratic choice. We welcome former President Vučić’s acceptance of the result and commitment to a peaceful democratic transition. Council of Europe stands ready to work with Serbia's democratically elected leadership to strengthen human rights, democracy and the rule of law. Your perseverance, energy and commitment to European principles and Serbia's future have brought you this far. You can count on our support," Berset wrote on X. MONTENEGRIN PRIME MINISTER MILOJKO SPAJIC "Today's events in Serbia are a vivid reminder that the will of the people and their right to freely decide their future are the foundation of every democratic change. The citizens of both countries deserve relations measured by concrete results of cooperation, not by the depth of diplomatic misunderstandings," Spajic wrote on X. HUNGARIAN PRIME MINISTER PETER MAGYAR "I have just spoken by phone with the leaders of the Students' List, who won the elections in Serbia, to congratulate them on their victory. I assured them of Hungary’s support. I was delighted to hear how much strength our victory in April had given them during this difficult struggle," Magyar wrote on X.

item.title: Los futuros sobre acciones estadounidenses suben mientras que el precio del petróleo crudo desciende
item.description: Los inversores se enfrentan a un periodo crucial, ya que las renovadas tensiones geopolíticas, la inflación persistente y las grietas en el sector de la inteligencia artificial ponen a prueba el apeti ...
item.dc:creator: Toby Alder
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los futuros de las acciones estadounidenses subieron y el precio del crudo retrocedió, mientras los operadores sopesaban los últimos acontecimientos geopolíticos relacionados con Irán y esperaban con interés la serie de decisiones sobre los tipos de interés que tomarán los bancos centrales esta semana. Los futuros del Nasdaq 100 subieron un 0,6 %, mientras que los contratos sobre el S&P 500 ganaron un 0,4 % tras la caída del índice de referencia el viernes. El Brent cayó más de un 1 %, hasta situarse en torno a los 115 dólares por barril, retrocediendo desde su cierre más alto desde abril. El presidente Donald Trump afirmó que “se acerca el momento de tomar una decisión” sobre si alcanzar un acuerdo con Teherán o reanudar los ataques, a medida que se intensifican las amenazas de Irán y los hutíes contra los estadounidenses en Oriente Medio. Las bolsas asiáticas parecían abocadas a un inicio mixto, con las subidas de los futuros estadounidenses ofreciendo cierto apoyo, mientras que la reciente debilidad de los valores tecnológicos las lastraba. Un índice de fabricantes de chips registró la semana pasada su racha más larga de pérdidas semanales desde noviembre, lo que pone en duda la solidez de cualquier repunte en el sector de la inteligencia artificial. El dólar se mantuvo en general estable frente a las divisas del Grupo de los 10 este lunes, tras cerrar la semana pasada a la baja. Los bonos del Tesoro habían cedido parte de sus ganancias anteriores el viernes, a medida que las acciones tecnológicas estadounidenses y los bonos franceses se estabilizaban. El euro cotizaba al alza a primera hora del lunes, después de que Francia evitara una rebaja de calificación por parte de Moody’s Ratings. Los inversores se enfrentan a un periodo crucial, ya que las renovadas tensiones geopolíticas, la inflación persistente y las grietas en el sector de la inteligencia artificial ponen a prueba el apetito por el riesgo de cara a noviembre. Las decisiones de los bancos centrales de EE. UU., la zona del euro y Japón esta semana supondrán la próxima prueba, en la que los responsables políticos deberán sopesar la amenaza del aumento de los costes energéticos frente a los indicios de tensión en los mercados financieros. “Nos mantenemos tácticamente reacios al riesgo hasta mediados de noviembre”, escribió Michael Hartnett, estratega de Bank of America Corp., en una nota a sus clientes. “Esperamos una tendencia a la baja en los rendimientos, en las acciones y en el dólar estadounidense”. La Reserva Federal subió los tipos de interés en septiembre por primera vez desde 2023 y señaló que era probable que se produjera otra subida este año. Aunque la inflación en EE. UU. se ha mantenido elevada, los responsables no han mostrado mucha urgencia por actuar de nuevo esta semana, y tanto economistas como inversores esperan que la próxima subida se produzca en diciembre. Es probable que los riesgos geopolíticos sigan siendo elevados de cara al próximo mes. Trump ha sugerido que los ataques estadounidenses contra Irán podrían reanudarse tras las elecciones de mitad de legislatura del 3 de noviembre, mientras que las autoridades han advertido de que el periodo comprendido entre las elecciones y la toma de posesión del nuevo Congreso podría resultar especialmente peligroso. Estados Unidos está reduciendo su presencia diplomática y militar en algunas zonas de Oriente Medio a medida que aumentan las amenazas procedentes de Irán y de los militantes hutíes de Yemen, respaldados por Irán. Los hutíes han atacado en repetidas ocasiones el aeropuerto de Riad, que reabrió el domingo para vuelos comerciales. “Todo apunta a una reanudación de la guerra y a una importante campaña de bombardeos, aunque el momento exacto sigue siendo incierto”, afirmó Aslı Aydıntaşbaş, experta en Oriente Medio de la Brookings Institution. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: トランプ氏、ミシガン民主候補をイスラム過激派と批判 9.11に言及
item.description:
Bo Erickson
[ポートヒューロン（米ミシガン州） ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson

[ポートヒューロン（米ミシガン州） ２５日 ロイター] - トランプ大統領は２５日、ミシガン州ポートヒューロンで開いた選挙集会で、民主党の上院議員候補アブドゥル・エルサイード氏をイスラム過激派と結び付ける取り組みを一段と強めた。同氏を２００１年９月１１日の米同時多発攻撃の実行犯になぞらえ、民主党が暴力的な反米テロリストの入国を容認すると主張した。

「ジハーディスト（イスラム聖戦主義者）でムスリム同胞団の一員である人物が米上院議員になるのを阻止するため、私はここに来た」と述べた。

エルサイード氏が当選すれば、イスラム教徒として初の米上院議員となる。トランプ氏は同氏を反米的なイスラム過激派として描こうとしてきたが、この日は発言をさらにエスカレートさせ、エルサイード氏を米同時多発攻撃でユナイテッド航空９３便を乗っ取った実行犯になぞらえた。

１１月３日の中間選挙に向け、共和党のマイク・ロジャース元下院議員とエルサイード氏が争うミシガン州の上院選は全米で最も激しい接戦の一つとなっている。

トランプ氏は、エルサイード氏に反対票を投じることを、９３便のハイジャック犯に抵抗したミシガン州出身のトッド・ビーマー氏らの行動になぞらえた。

「２５年がたった今、ミシガン州はトッドと同じように立ち上がって戦い、ジハーディストが連邦議会に足を踏み入れるのを阻止しなければならない」と訴え、エルサイード氏が当選すれば「上院に入る前に金属探知機を通らなければならない唯一の上院議員になるだろう」と述べた。

ミシガン州では民主党のオバマ元大統領が２４日に応援演説を行っており、今回の選挙における同州の重要性が浮き彫りになった。

item.title: Why China’s stimulus keeps missing the mark
item.description: China's economy has split in two: high-tech exports are surging, while domestic consumption and job creation are stalling. Now that major trading partners are seeking to put up more barriers, Beijing may need to rethink its cautious approach to direct household stimulus.
item.dc:creator: Manishi Raychaudhuri
item.content:encoded: China's economy has split in two: high-tech exports are surging, while domestic consumption and job creation are stalling. Now that major trading partners are seeking to put up more barriers, Beijing may need to rethink its cautious approach to direct household stimulus. China's K-shaped economy was clearly illustrated by its third-quarter GDP figures. Exceptional export growth, driven by global AI spending and clean energy investment, helped GDP growth hit 4.5% year-on-year. While retail sales rose slightly, the increase came from a low base, and the multi-year housing slump continued to weigh on the domestic economy. The housing slump partly explains the consumption woes. With residential property accounting for about 70% of Chinese household assets on average, dwindling home prices since 2021 have eroded household wealth and constrained consumption. Meanwhile, increasing job insecurity appears to be driving up precautionary savings. The official urban unemployment rate has held around 5% over the past three years, but youth unemployment has hovered between 14% and 19%, underscoring the obstacles to creating new jobs. A 2024 survey by the People’s Bank of China attributed the country’s rising savings rate to the weak job market. DIVERGENT BY DESIGN This divergent growth pattern reflects Beijing's policy choices. Technological self-sufficiency has long been China's stated long-term strategic goal. China's “New Quality Productive Forces” growth model, articulated in late 2023 , called for generous investment in digitalization, networking, biotechnology and AI. In March, the [USN:L8N3ZR09Y TEXT:"15th Five-Year Plan"] reinforced this model, elevating six emerging industries – AI and robotics, semiconductors, advanced mobile communications, quantum technologies, biotechnology and drones and air taxis – as pillars of future growth. There may be merits to this strategy given the tech arms race with the US, but it appears to come at the expense of domestic consumption, as it generates negative wealth effects, limits the resources available for social safety nets and reduces support for labor-intensive industries. For example, since 2020, Beijing has [USN:L6N45703P TEXT:"shifted policy"] to divert capital away from real estate and toward advanced manufacturing and green energy. In this period, outstanding bank loans to the property sector have flattened, while those to manufacturing and green technology have grown at annual rates of 10-15% and 20-40%, respectively. This, in turn, has inhibited the recovery in the property sector, which has weighed on domestic consumption. While generous investments in advanced manufacturing and green technology may boost GDP growth, they have not alleviated the country's unemployment problem. As the International Monetary Fund (IMF) [USN:L1N3LX0C0 TEXT:"has warned"], the shift toward sectors like electric vehicles (EVs) reshapes employment toward capital-intensive, highly automated production rather than broad job creation. Moreover, [USN:L4N2P31JT TEXT:"regulatory crackdowns"] have negatively impacted white-collar work: research on China's private education ban shows it wiped out 3 million jobs alone, alongside massive layoffs at [USN:L5N2VH0RL TEXT:"internet platforms"] and developers. Even though Beijing’s focus on advanced manufacturing, AI, clean energy and other industries of the future makes strategic sense on the global stage – and may be the envy of the US and the European Union – at home, these priorities have left Chinese consumers facing a host of economic headwinds. NARROWING OPTIONS The combination of breathtaking expansion in manufacturing capacity and weak domestic demand has led to overcapacity in many sectors, much of which has been exported – a [USN:L6N45Z06C TEXT:"charge frequently levelled"] by the US and the EU. This overcapacity has driven a destructive race for domestic market share, crushing prices and margins across EVs, solar panels, batteries and e-commerce. So far, Beijing's plans to combat this "involution" have met with limited success. Meanwhile, major trading partners, including [USN:S8N42Q0FC TEXT:"the EU"], are beginning to erect trade barriers, narrowing the scope for export-led growth. This highlights the risks China could face if it fails to revive household consumption. China has periodically attempted to boost domestic demand. A coordinated [USN:L1N3L6043 TEXT:"monetary"] and [USN:L4N3LN0KU TEXT:"fiscal"] package in September 2024 included sharp cuts to banks' reserve requirement ratios and benchmark policy rates, as well as relaxed home-purchase restrictions. The central government also embarked on local-government debt resolution and support for low-income households. In contrast, a new set of measures announced [USN:P8N44P093 TEXT:"last month"] was much less ambitious, focusing on capital injections into state-owned banks and insurance companies as well as consumer credit subsidies. Chinese policymakers have also been reluctant to commit to concrete consumption targets. Several government advisers [USN:L4N3T10FN TEXT:"recommended"] that the upcoming 15th Five-Year Plan include a target to raise household consumption from 40% of GDP to 50% over the next two five-year cycles, but that recommendation went unheeded. The lighter fiscal touch is not surprising given growing debt constraints. China's total government debt, including central, local and off-balance-sheet government financing vehicles, has risen from 80% of GDP in 2019 to 127% in 2025, according to the IMF. Additionally, rebalancing the economy would require more than fiscal and monetary support. The IMF has suggested reallocating public resources from production to households, enhancing social safety nets for healthcare, unemployment and pensions, and relaxing the household registration system, or hukou, to grant urban status to 200 million rural migrant workers. But such recommendations have received a lukewarm response. While some officials in Beijing have indicated that the country should rebalance away from exports and toward consumption, doing so would likely mean slower growth in the short term and could require adjustments that would be painful to certain segments of the economy. Ultimately, China's economic rebalancing faces a deep structural impasse. Whether it can overcome it may be the key question for the global economy in the next decade. (The views expressed here are those of Manishi Raychaudhuri , the founder and CEO of Emmer Capital Partners Ltd and the former head of Asia-Pacific Equity Research at BNP Paribas Securities.) item.title: Belgrade in rapture as Serbian students topple Vucic in historic election
item.description: Trams and traffic halted by crowds. Tens of thousands of people choking the city's main boulevards; the air thick with smoke; a man on a car waving a flare.
item.dc:creator: Edward Mcallister, Kirsten Donovan, Aleksandar Vasovic
item.content:encoded: Trams and traffic halted by crowds. Tens of thousands of people choking the city's main boulevards; the air thick with smoke; a man on a car waving a flare. Familiar-sounding scenes after a month of sometimes violent protests across European cities as students take to the streets calling for better education standards and better prospects. Except, on Sunday night in Serbia's capital Belgrade, students were not protesting but celebrating an election victory after long-time ruler Aleksandar Vucic [USN:L6N46B017 TEXT:"conceded defeat"] to a student-backed list of candidates in parliamentary elections. It was the culmination of a two-year, [USN:L8N4650K6 TEXT:"peaceful protest movement"] that called for Vucic to step down and an end to what they said is rampant corruption in the Balkan country - a charge Vucic denies. The students' win marks a profound political shift in the country of some 6 million people and shows what power younger generation have when they are able to harness widespread discontent. "That is the best thing that happened in my life. We will now breathe freely," said Milica, a law student. Vucic had ruled as prime minister or president since 2014, and oversaw a period of strong economic growth, but he faced growing opposition from student-led protests after the collapse of a railway station awning killed 16 people in November 2024. Tomorrow, the disparate group of 250 student-backed candidates will have to turn towards ruling, but Sunday evening was a time to party. At their headquarters, the unknown candidates, many of them lawyers, professors, actors or farmers, hugged and cheered in near disbelief at what they had achieved. "The people have won! The people defeated a dictator! The people will lead Serbia!" said Nebojsa Cosic while waving a flag on the street.

item.title: 英首相、ＥＵとの労働者移動自由化巡る議論に前向き
item.description:
William Schomberg
[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
William Schomberg

[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - バーナム英首相は、労働者の自由な移動に関する欧州連合（ＥＵ）規則への復帰について議論したいとの意向を示した。労働者の移動の自由は、英国のＥＵ離脱につながった２０１６年の国民投票で主要な争点となった。

バーナム氏はこれまでもＥＵとの関係を見直す必要性に言及しており、英紙サンデー・タイムズに対し、離脱前のＥＵからの労働者流入は非常に大きな課題をもたらしたと指摘。一方で「同時に、今ほど対応が難しくない種類の移民だったのかもしれない」と述べた。

「人々が来ては帰っていく回転ドア型の移民は事情が違う。当時から移民の構成は変わったのではないか。こうしたことについて率直に議論する必要があると思う」と語った。

公式統計によると、２０２５年の長期移民の純流入数は、ＥＵ離脱後の新たな移民制度が導入された２１年初めより前の水準近くまで減少した。

バーナム氏は９月、ＥＵとの将来の関係について、最終的にＥＵに復帰する選択肢も含めて検討すべきだと述べた。

それ以前には、移動の自由を復活させないことなどを盛り込んだスターマー前政権の公約を支持していた。ＥＵは、移動の自由を単一市場への参加条件としている。

バーナム氏は１０月１９日に行われたサンデー・タイムズのインタビューで、移動の自由の問題は、データ共有や移民などを含むＥＵとの関係の幅広い再構築の一環として検討できるという考えを示した。

「移動の自由だけを切り離して考えるのではなく、全体として捉えなければならない」と語った。

英国の経済成長を加速させる方策を模索するバーナム氏は、１１月２０日にＥＵ首脳らと会談する予定だ。

１６年の国民投票でＥＵ残留を訴えた保守党のハント元財務相は、当時の根本的な論点の一つを再び持ち出すのは誤りだと指摘。移民規制の緩和は英国の人々に打撃を与えると述べた。

item.title: Flávio ultrapassa Lula e tem 50,03% contra 49,97%, com 13,98% das seções apuradas, mostra TSE
item.description: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) ultrapassou o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e liderava a apuração do segundo turno da eleição presidencial deste domingo com 50,08% dos votos válidos, enquanto o presidente Lula somava 49,92%, com 15,06% das seções eleitorais apuradas, segundo dados do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) ultrapassou o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e liderava a apuração do segundo turno da eleição presidencial deste domingo com 50,08% dos votos válidos, enquanto o presidente Lula somava 49,92%, com 15,06% das seções eleitorais apuradas, segundo dados do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE). O horário de votação, inicialmente previsto para encerrar às 17h, foi ampliado em duas horas por decisão do ministro Cristiano Zanin, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), após pedidos das duas campanhas que alegaram problemas com transporte público e causados pelas chuvas em algumas cidades. (Reportagem de Eduardo Simões e Fernando Cardoso; Edição de Alexandre Caverni)

item.title: Real Madrid derrota 2-1 al Barcelona en el Camp Nou con doblete de Mbappé y se acerca
item.description: El Real Madrid se convirtió el domingo en el primer equipo en vencer al Barcelona en LaLiga esta temporada al vencer 2-1 al campeón defensor en el Camp Nou con un doblete de Kylian Mbappé.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: El Real Madrid se convirtió el domingo en el primer equipo en vencer al Barcelona en LaLiga esta temporada al vencer 2-1 al campeón defensor en el Camp Nou con un doblete de Kylian Mbappé. El undécimo gol de Mbappé en 10 partidos de LaLiga le dio la victoria al DT José Mourinho en su regreso al Clásico 13 años después de que terminara su primera etapa en el Real Madrid. Con el triunfo, los blancos redujeron la diferencia con el Barcelona a solo tres puntos. En una primera parte muy igualada, ambos equipos crearon una serie de ocasiones de gol, pero las incursiones ofensivas del Madrid tuvieron mucha más determinación. La frustración de Hansi Flick en la banda sirvió como prueba de que el plan de juego de Mourinho estaba funcionando mejor que el suyo. En el minuto 41, Yan Diomande centró desde la izquierda y el despeje suave de Gerard Martin rebotó en Mbappé, que salía a su encuentro, y el balón acabó en el fondo de la red. El Barcelona tuvo la oportunidad de empatar antes del descanso tras un rebote, pero Lamine Yamal no pudo convertir desde cerca. El Barca igualó en el minuto 61, cuando un pase de Pedri encontró a Raphinha con espacio en el área. El brasileño remató cruzado para poner el 1-1. La rápida circulación del balón del Madrid en su propio campo siguió dejando al descubierto la defensa del Barcelona en los primeros compases de la segunda parte, pero tras el gol, a los visitantes les resultó cada vez más difícil escapar de la presión del conjunto culé. Pese a todo, la defensa del Madrid logró sostenerse, y el equipo de Mourinho seguía generando peligro en ataque. Esa convicción defensiva tuvo su recompensa a tres minutos del final. Un mal control de Gabriel Jesus propició un contraataque del Madrid. Eduardo Camavinga logró colarse entre la defensa antes de pasarle el balón a Mbappé, quien solo tuvo que empujarlo a la red vacía. El triunfo fue lo suficientemente convincente como para sugerir que el Madrid supondrá un serio desafío al título para el equipo catalán tras dos temporadas decepcionantes. "Ha sido un gran partido, que seguramente todo el mundo que ama el fútbol se ha parado para ver, con dos equipos que jugaron a ganar y en nuestro caso (...) los chicos han hecho un partido extraordinario, muy organizados, concentrados, con coraje para salir jugando desde atrás con un adversario que presiona mucho", dijo Mourinho tras el encuentro. El Barcelona se mantiene líder de LaLiga con 27 puntos en 10 partidos, uno más que el Atlético de Madrid, que aparece segundo. El Real Madrid, tercero, suma 24 unidades.

item.title: Anthropic's Claude accessed Georgia state vote count data behind paywall
item.description: AI model Claude bypassed a paywall and accessed publicly available US state of Georgia aggregate voter counts without human authorization, Anthropic said in a statement on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: AI model Claude bypassed a paywall and accessed publicly available US state of Georgia aggregate voter counts without human authorization, Anthropic said in a statement on Sunday. "Claude didn't access the state's voter registration system or change or pull any voting records," Anthropic said, adding that it has since taken steps to block these kinds of actions. Anthropic said in a blog post earlier this month it found examples of Claude "working around a restriction to reach data that was gated by a token or a fee" and some of these cases involved websites run by US government agencies at the federal, state, and local levels. The secretary of state's office in Georgia did not respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours. Axios first reported the unauthorized action by Claude.

item.title: ブラジル大統領選決選投票、ボルソナロ氏がルラ氏を逆転 開票14％超
item.description: [サンパウロ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[サンパウロ ２５日 ロイター] - ブラジルで２５日に大統領選の決選投票が行われ、選挙管理当局の暫定集計によると、右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員が現職の左派ルラ大統領を逆転した。ただ、最高裁の判断を受けて開票が一時中断され、接戦に混乱をもたらしている。

開票率１４％超の時点で、前大統領の息子であるボルソナロ氏の得票率は５０．０２％と、ルラ氏の４９．９８％を上回った。

ボルソナロ氏が勝利すれば、中南米でトランプ米大統領に友好的な右派候補の勝利が続くことになる。一方、ルラ氏が通算４期目を務めることになれば、地域における米政府の影響力に対抗する防波堤となる。ルラ政権は米国の通商・安全保障政策に抵抗している。

ただ、選挙戦は法的紛争にもつれ込む恐れが出てきた。最高裁の判事が、バイア州の３都市で公共交通機関に問題が生じたとして、ルラ陣営による投票時間延長の要請を認めたためだ。決定を下した判事はかつてルラ氏の弁護士を務めたこともある。この判断を受け、高等選挙裁判所は開票を２時間中断した。
