item.title: 仏極右の大統領候補ルペン氏、選挙戦を正式開始 治安回復など公約
item.description:
Lafken Zepeda Nicolas Economou
[オルレアン（フランス） ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Lafken Zepeda　Nicolas Economou

[オルレアン（フランス） ２５日 ロイター] - フランスの極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」を事実上率いるマリーヌ・ルペン氏は２５日、来年の大統領選に向けた選挙戦を正式に開始し、治安回復と国民の信頼取り戻しを公約に掲げた。

世論調査で首位を走るルペン氏は、経済、社会、治安を巡る危機が深まっていると主張し、自らがそれらの課題に対処できる最適な候補だと訴えた。

ルペン氏は選挙戦最初の演説地として中部オルレアンを選んだ。オルレアンは、愛国主義と国家主権の象徴として民族主義者から敬愛される１５世紀の英雄ジャンヌ・ダルクゆかりの地として知られる。

支持者を前に演説したルペン氏は「私たちは世界の終わりを生きているのではなく、彼らの世界の終わりを生きている」と述べて対立陣営を批判するとともに、徹底した治安維持政策を打ち出し、安全確保は国家の最優先の責務だと強調した。

フランスでは生活費高騰や格差拡大への抗議デモが略奪や破壊行為に発展しており、こうした社会不安がルペン氏への支持拡大につながっている。

２５日に公表された世論調査によると、ルペン氏の支持率は３２．０─３３．５％で、極左政党「不屈のフランス」を率いる２位のジャンリュック・メランション氏の１７％を大きく上回った。主流政党から有権者が離れ、政治的両極端への支持が強まっていることがうかがえる。

調査では、来年５月上旬に予定される決選投票でルペン氏がメランション氏を容易に破るとの見方も示された。

ルペン氏は演説で「ルネサンス（再生）」も重要なテーマに掲げ、フランスは混乱期にあるものの、治安強化と繁栄、国家再建を柱とする自身の構想を受け入れれば、さらに強い国になると断言。「以前は良かった。そして明日はもっと良くなる」と語り、楽観的な未来像を示した。

移民政策については国境管理の復活、外国人犯罪者の自動追放、ギャングや麻薬密売組織への取り締まり強化を公約した。

経済政策は、歳出抑制、法人税負担の軽減、規制緩和、産業振興やイノベーション、人工知能（ＡＩ）への支援を打ち出し、年金支給開始年齢のさらなる引き上げには反対した。

欧州政策は、フランスの欧州連合（ＥＵ）離脱は主張しなかったものの、ＥＵの影響力を縮小し、国境や法律に対する国家主権を回復すると表明。対外戦争への関与を避けるなど「フランス第一」の立場を鮮明にした。

ルペン氏は最後に「未来は私たちのものだ」と述べ、支持者らとともに国歌を斉唱して演説を締めくくった。

item.title: Real Madrid vence Barcelona no Camp Nou
item.description: O Real Madrid tornou-se neste domingo a primeira equipe a derrotar o Barcelona na atual temporada da LaLiga, ao vencer o clássico por 2 a 1 no Camp Nou, com dois gols de Kylian Mbappé.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: O Real Madrid tornou-se neste domingo a primeira equipe a derrotar o Barcelona na atual temporada da LaLiga, ao vencer o clássico por 2 a 1 no Camp Nou, com dois gols de Kylian Mbappé. O atacante francês abriu o placar aos 41 minutos do primeiro tempo ao desviar para o gol uma tentativa de corte de Gerard Martín. O Barcelona empatou aos 16 minutos da etapa final. Após uma cobrança rápida de escanteio, Pedri encontrou Raphinha livre na área, e o brasileiro bateu no canto, sem chances para o goleiro Andriy Lunin. Quando a partida parecia caminhar para o empate, Eduardo Camavinga avançou pela esquerda e cruzou para Mbappé marcar o gol da vitória aos 42 minutos do segundo tempo. Apesar da derrota, o Barcelona segue na liderança da LaLiga, com 27 pontos em 10 jogos, um a mais que o vice-líder Atlético de Madrid. O Real Madrid ocupa a terceira colocação, com 24 pontos. (Reportagem de Ruairidh Barlow)

item.title: セルビア議会選、ブチッチ大統領敗北認める 学生主導勢力が歴史的勝利
item.description:
Ivana Sekularac Edward McAllister Aleksandar Vasovic
[ベオグラード ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ivana Sekularac　Edward McAllister　Aleksandar Vasovic

[ベオグラード ２５日 ロイター] - セルビアのブチッチ大統領は、２５日に行われた議会選挙で、自身が率いる与党セルビア進歩党が、学生主導の新興政治勢力「学生リスト」に敗北したことを認めた。長年にわたる同氏の統治に終止符が打たれたセルビアの政治は、新たな時代を迎えることになった。

ブチッチ氏の敗北表明を受け、首都ベオグラードでは市民らが街頭に繰り出して祝賀。車のクラクションが鳴り響き、学生らは「勝利だ」「彼は終わった」と歓声を上げた。

今回の前倒し総選挙は、２０２４年に北部ノビサドの駅で屋根のひさしが崩落し、１６人が死亡した事故を契機に始まった学生主導の抗議運動を背景に実施された。参加者らは汚職の横行や権威主義化の進行に反発し、約２年間にわたりデモを続けてきた。

学生側本部で演説したベオグラード大のラドミル・サイチッチ教授は「セルビアの皆さん、今夜、国民の声が届いた。今夜は勝利を祝い、明日から未来を築く」と語った。

投票率は約７０％に達し、１９９２年のユーゴスラビア解体以降で最高水準を記録。各地の投票所には長い列ができ、変化を求める有権者の強い意志が示された。

ブチッチ氏は開票速報に基づいて「われわれが敗れたことは明らかだ。学生リストは１３５－１４０議席を獲得し、われわれは１０５議席となる見通しだ。ほかの勢力は議会入りできない」と述べた。

調査機関ＣＥＳＩＤ・ＩＰＳＰＳの出口調査によると、学生リストは定数２５０の議会で１３８議席を獲得する見込み。セルビア進歩党は１０４議席にとどまった。残る議席は少数民族政党に配分される見通しだ。

ベオグラードで祝賀に参加した女性タニャさんは「信じられないほど幸せだ。ついにこのマフィアを追い払うことができた。うれし過ぎて言葉も出ない」と喜びを語った。

item.title: アウディＣＥＯ、トランプ氏発表の米新工場建設計画を正当化
item.description:
Bo Erickson David Shepardson Rachel More
[ペリー（米ジョージア州）／ベルリン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アウディＣＥＯ、トランプ氏発表の米新工場建設計画を正当化 7:36 配信

アウディのロゴ。2025年2月26日、オランダのネイメーヘンで撮影。REUTERS/Piroschka van de Wouw

Bo Erickson　David Shepardson　Rachel More

[ペリー（米ジョージア州）／ベルリン ２５日 ロイター] - ドイツ自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）傘下アウディのゲルノート・デルナー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２５日、トランプ米大統領が発表した同社による米南部ジョージア州での４０億ドル（約５８００億円）規模の新工場建設計画について「数カ月にわたる慎重な計画と集中的な交渉を経た決定だ」と述べ、妥当な判断だと強調した。投資計画の実施にはＶＷ監査役会の最終承認が必要となる。

デルナー氏は２４日、ジョージア州ペリーで開かれたトランプ大統領の集会に登壇。トランプ氏はアウディが同州に年産２０万台規模のＳＵＶ（スポーツタイプ多目的車）組立工場を建設する計画だと明らかにした。

デルナー氏は記者団に「米大統領から招待を受ければ応じる。投資先の国とその職務に敬意を示すためだ」と語っていた。

ジョージア州では１１月３日の中間選挙の上院選と知事選が接戦となっており、トランプ氏は自らの自動車関税政策が米経済と国内製造業を押し上げていると有権者に訴えている。

アウディによると、自動車や鉄鋼、アルミニウム、部品に対するトランプ政権の関税措置により、同社は昨年約１２億ユーロ（１４億ドル）の負担を強いられた。同社は米国向け車両を欧州とメキシコから輸入している。デルナー氏はそうした関税の軽減措置が含まれるかどうかなど米国との合意内容の詳細については明らかにしなかった。

ドイツ最大の産業別労働組合ＩＧメタルの報道担当者は、デルナー氏が選挙期間中にトランプ氏との協調姿勢を示したことについて「理解し難い。トランプ氏はドイツの自動車産業を含む国内経済を弱体化させようとしていることを隠していない」と批判した。

ＩＧメタル委員長でＶＷ監査役会副会長を務めるクリスティアーネ・ベナー氏は、新工場建設による米市場での競争力強化は「正しく必要なことだ」と評価した一方で「特にドイツ国内の各拠点で働く従業員の将来について明確な見通しを示す必要がある」と指摘した。

ＶＷ第２位株主のニーダーザクセン州のリース州首相は、米国での生産拡大はドイツ国内の雇用維持につながれば好機だとの見方を示すとともに「米国での成長はドイツ国内の雇用と付加価値創出を確保するものでなければならず、置き換えになってはならない」と述べた。

アウディによると、新工場によって約４５００人の雇用が創出される見込み。建設は来年開始し、生産は２０３０年代初頭に始まる予定だ。

ロイターが米政府当局者の話として報じたところでは、新工場では「Ｑ７」「Ｑ８」「Ｑ９」の各ＳＵＶを組み立てる計画。またアウディは隣接するサウスカロライナ州でも年２万５０００台を生産する方針で、一部車種は欧州から移管され、輸出にも充てられる見通しという。

これらの車両は、サウスカロライナ州ブライスウッドで建設中のＶＷ傘下ブランド「スカウト・モーターズ」の総額２０億ドルの工場で組み立てられる予定だ。

ＶＷのオリバー・ブルーメＣＥＯは「北米地域を収益性の高い成長市場と位置付けている。米国内のアウディ新工場はその条件をさらに整える形になる」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 アングル：トランプ氏の「信任投票」化戦略、共和党内に懐疑論も アングル：米保守活動家カーク氏暗殺から1年、設立団体拡大も若年層にトランプ離れ アングル：ＧＭもアウディも、中国に開発委ねる自動車大手　狙いはＥＶやソフトの技術力 最終更新: 10/26(月) 7:36 ロイター

item.title: 北朝鮮、地雷爆発巡り国連に韓国非難の書簡 主権侵害に警告
item.description:
[ソウル ２６日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮は国連安全保障理事会に書簡を送り、韓国が９月の地雷事件を捏造し、境界地帯の要塞化作業に当たる北朝鮮兵士を危険にさらしていると非難した。国営の朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が２６日報じた。
• ＫＣＮＡによると、北朝鮮の国連代表は２５日の書簡で、韓国政府が地雷事件を利用し、北朝鮮の境界地帯での建設作業を軍事的な侵入と印象付けようとしていると主張。主権が侵害されれば、自衛措置につながる可能性があると警告した。
• 問題となっているのは、９月２１日に南北間の非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で発生した爆発。この爆発により、韓国軍兵士２人が重傷を負った。
• 韓国政府はその後、ＤＭＺ内を通る軍事境界線（ＭＤＬ）の南側に北朝鮮が埋設した地雷が爆発の原因だったと発表。国連軍司令部は、北朝鮮の地雷が軍事境界線を越えた場所に埋設されていたことは休戦協定違反だと指摘した。北朝鮮政府は責任を否定している。
•
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル ２６日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮は国連安全保障理事会に書簡を送り、韓国が９月の地雷事件を捏造し、境界地帯の要塞化作業に当たる北朝鮮兵士を危険にさらしていると非難した。国営の朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が２６日報じた。

• ＫＣＮＡによると、北朝鮮の国連代表は２５日の書簡で、韓国政府が地雷事件を利用し、北朝鮮の境界地帯での建設作業を軍事的な侵入と印象付けようとしていると主張。主権が侵害されれば、自衛措置につながる可能性があると警告した。

• 問題となっているのは、９月２１日に南北間の非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で発生した爆発。この爆発により、韓国軍兵士２人が重傷を負った。

• 韓国政府はその後、ＤＭＺ内を通る軍事境界線（ＭＤＬ）の南側に北朝鮮が埋設した地雷が爆発の原因だったと発表。国連軍司令部は、北朝鮮の地雷が軍事境界線を越えた場所に埋設されていたことは休戦協定違反だと指摘した。北朝鮮政府は責任を否定している。

• 北朝鮮は書簡で、韓国が北朝鮮側の要員に発砲したとも非難。他国の領土保全に対する武力による威嚇や武力行使を禁じた国連憲章に違反すると主張した。

• 韓国政府は、北朝鮮軍兵士が軍事境界線を越えた際には、北側に引き返させるため警告放送と警告射撃を行っていると説明している。

• 北朝鮮軍は近年、軍事境界線付近で軍用道路やフェンスの建設、地雷の敷設を進めている。

• 韓国国防省は２３日、偶発的な衝突のリスクを低減するため、北朝鮮に軍事会談を改めて提案した。

item.title: UK commits to further £432 million to end rough sleeping
item.description: Britain's government said on Sunday it would almost double its funding for efforts to end rough sleeping and give homeless people a way to get off the streets in the winter months.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's government said on Sunday it would almost double its funding for efforts to end rough sleeping and give homeless people a way to get off the streets in the winter months. Prime Minister Andy Burnham and finance minister John Healey said they would commit a further £432 million ($577.7 million) of funding for the plan, which offers accommodation and support, to run until the scheduled end of parliament in 2029. Burnham said on his first day in Downing Street in July that he wanted to end rough sleeping. He was due to meeting local leaders, businesses and charities on Monday to discuss the plan. Healey is scheduled to announce his first budget plan on Wednesday. ($1 = 0.7478 pounds)

item.title: Leafs riding 'great' vibes while Flames try to finish perfect homestand
item.description: The Calgary Flames and visiting Toronto Maple Leafs will strive to continue their win streaks in the face of key injury absences when they meet on Monday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Calgary Flames and visiting Toronto Maple Leafs will strive to continue their win streaks in the face of key injury absences when they meet on Monday night. The Maple Leafs will wrap up the Alberta section of their road trip coming off the high point of their season so far. Toronto scored four third-period goals in a 7-2 battering of Edmonton on Saturday to extend its winning streak to four games, its first of that length since January. "The vibes are great," said goaltender Anthony Stolarz, who made 30 saves on the night. "We got a great group, an influx of kids that have a lot of energy, and they're really bringing out the best in everyone. It's an exciting time to be a Maple Leaf." The ongoing absence of second-line center John Tavares (lower-body injury) has afforded head coach Jim Hiller the opportunity to prove that the Maple Leafs' forward corps offers more than the one-two punch of years past. Thirteen different players recorded a point on Saturday, and every member of the fourth line -- Brandon Duhaime, Teddy Blueger and Zack MacEwen -- nabbed their first goal in blue and white over the last two games. As a team, Toronto has scored 18 goals over the last three. "That to me says something about your team. That says you've got depth. That says it's not just (Auston) Matthews. It's not just (William) Nylander. It's not just Tavares. It's going through the lineup, and that gives you a chance to win every night," Hiller said. Toronto conceded its first power-play goal on the road against the Oilers, though they still lead the NHL in penalty kill percentage (95.2%) and special-teams efficiency (125.4%). After losing six of their first seven games, the Flames will have a chance to extend their own winning streak to four as they wrap up their four-game homestand. Devin Cooley made 28 saves as Calgary thumped the Detroit Red Wings 4-1 Saturday. "We've just been stacking wins and stacking good play the last couple games here," said Joel Farabee, who had three points on the night. "We just have a little bit of confidence and a little bit of swagger right now that maybe we didn't have the first five or six games of the season. We're just finding how we have to play to win and just trying not to do too much and playing simple." The Flames have managed to reverse their fortunes with something of a depleted offense. Jonathan Huberdeau (hip) remains sidelined for the foreseeable future while captain Mikael Backlund (upper-body injury) has missed the last two outings. Lacking genuine star power at the top of their lineup, Calgary will continue to count on a distributed workload and a high-functioning power play, which is 6-for-12 over its last four games. Nine of the team's 12 forwards logged at least twelve minutes at even strength against Detroit. "When the power play is scoring and things are going their way, they start feeling really good about playing on the ice and they know they can be difference-makers and that's the phase they're in right now," said head coach Ryan Huska. Toronto will likely continue to rotate players in and out of their defensive pairings amid the injury absences of Chris Tanev, Nick Blankenburg and Marshall Rifai. The Maple Leafs have won the last eight encounters between the two teams. --Field Level Media

item.title: スペースＸ、400億ドル調達 マスク氏「ネオクラウド再編」予測
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - 米宇宙関連企業スペースＸのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２５日、画像処理装置（ＧＰ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
スペースＸ、400億ドル調達　マスク氏「ネオクラウド再編」予測 7:28 配信

米宇宙関連企業スペースＸのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）。2026年10月8日、米首都ワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Evan Vucci/File Photo/File Photo

[２５日 ロイター] - 米宇宙関連企業スペースＸのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２５日、画像処理装置（ＧＰＵ）の購入に向けた４００億ドルの債務による資金調達を完了したとＸで明らかにした。

同社の格付けが投資適格級であることや、スターリンクの衛星インターネット事業およびロケット打ち上げ事業による収入が寄与したと説明した。

ただ、資金調達を「完了した」という発言の意味や、投資家が債務の価格条件に合意したかどうかは、投稿からは直ちに明らかにならなかった。

マスク氏は「これは主に（２０２７年）第１・四半期および第２・四半期に納入されるＧＰＵの購入に向けた早期償還可能な債務だ。この四半期（２６年第４・四半期）に大きな影響を与えるものではない」と述べた。

ブレット・ジョンセン最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）によると、同社は第４・四半期の設備投資を３５０億─４００億ドルと見込んでいる。

スペースＸが人工知能（ＡＩ）向けのエヌビディア製半導体を購入するため、４００億ドルの資金調達を目指していることはロイターが既に報じていた。

テクノロジー各社がＡＩ開発に必要な先端半導体の確保と演算インフラの構築を競う中、今回の資金調達は、ＡＩブームに伴う巨額の資金需要を浮き彫りにしている。

マスク氏は、債務市場では「ＡＩデータセンター以外から多額の収入を得ていない企業は、資金調達の道をほぼ完全に閉ざされている」と述べた。

このため、ＡＩ向けクラウドサービスに特化した「ネオクラウド」企業の間で大規模な再編や経営破綻が起きると予測。その後、スペースＸがネオクラウド企業を買収することはないとし、「無意味だ」と述べた。

幅広い業種にサービスを提供する大手クラウド企業とは異なり、ネビウスやコアウィーブなどのネオクラウド企業は、主にテクノロジー企業を顧客とし、ＡＩ技術向けに特化した演算能力を提供している。

スペースＸの第３・四半期（７―９月期）の売上高は前年同期の２．６１倍の１４５億８０００万ドルに達した。設備投資は３倍の１９６億ドルに膨らみ、演算インフラへの支出がかさんだ。

ＡＩ関連売上高は約１０倍の７５億６０００万ドルに急増し、ＡＩへの巨額投資が成果を上げつつあることを、これまでで最も明確に示した。

スペースＸと、同じくマスク氏がＣＥＯを務めるテスラによる半導体製造合弁事業「テラファブ」は２８年第３・四半期までに量産開始を目指している。来年５月または６月ごろに最初の試験用半導体の生産に乗り出す見込みだ。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ＮＡＳＡローマン宇宙望遠鏡打ち上げへ、ダークエネルギーやダークマターの解明期待 アングル：米金融大手、第2四半期は軒並み好決算　投資銀・取引部門がけん引 アングル：スペースＸ株が公開価格割れ、投資家の信頼守れるか　他案件に影響も アングル：米国で新たに44万人の「ＡＩ長者」、高級品の支出と嗜好にも変化 焦点：ラッセル指数銘柄入れ替えで26日は米株取引急増か、スペースＸなど注目 最終更新: 10/26(月) 8:35 ロイター

item.title: New-look Heat search for first win as Mavericks visit
item.description: With three losses to open the season, the Miami Heat are still looking for the first win of the Giannis Antetokounmpo Era.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: With three losses to open the season, the Miami Heat are still looking for the first win of the Giannis Antetokounmpo Era. The Heat get another shot at that elusive victory on Monday night when they play host to the Dallas Mavericks. Antetokounmpo averaged 35.5 points in his first two games in a Heat uniform, but he was held to 14 on Saturday in a 115-110 loss at Charlotte. He played just 25 minutes before fouling out with 1:57 remaining. A 10-time All-Star, two-time NBA MVP and one-time league champion, Antetokounmpo was the prize in the huge offseason trade with the Milwaukee Bucks. But the question then -- and now -- was whether Miami gave up too much to get him. Specifically, do the Heat have enough shooters to put around him? Bam Adebayo, Miami's other established star, is off to a slow start as he averages 13.0 points and 7.0 rebounds per game. Point guard Davion Mitchell has stepped up, averaging 17.0 points on 46.7% 3-point shooting. Both numbers would easily be career highs for Mitchell, a player known more for tight defense. Aside from those three players, nobody on the Heat averages more than 10.3 points. Andrew Wiggins (18.2% on 3-point attempts) and Tim Hardaway Jr. (17.6% from deep) are off to poor shooting starts that are similar to Adebayo (23.1%) and Antetokounmpo (16.7%). Miami coach Erik Spoelstra knows it's early, though, and said this is all part of this version of the Heat learning to handle adversity. "We're all on the same page when shots are going down," Spoelstra said after the loss to Charlotte. "But when the game goes the other way, we really introduce ourselves to each other and collectively build a resolve." Meanwhile, the Mavericks are coming off a 122-106 home loss to San Antonio on Saturday. Dallas played without reigning Rookie of the Year Cooper Flagg, who injured his left shoulder in a 121-105 win over Indiana on Friday and will be re-evaluated this week. Nine-time All-Star Kyrie Irving, coming off knee surgery, also sat against San Antonio but is expected to be ready to face the Heat. Without that duo on Saturday, Dallas was led by rookie reserve Sergio de Larrea, the No. 25 pick in this year's draft (by the Los Angeles Lakers). A native of Spain, de Larrea is a skilled combo guard listed at 6-foot-5 and 175 pounds. At age 20, he offers Dallas hope that he could develop into a star. He produced 21 points, five rebounds and four assists in 33 minutes against the Spurs after going scoreless in eight minutes during the Mavs' first two games. "Today it was me, but other days it will be other guys," said de Larrea. "I'm waiting every day for this moment. I'm just trying to be prepared, but I have a lot to improve." Irving, if he's ready, will try to improve on his 19.5 scoring average. Flagg leads the team with 23.0 points per game. --Field Level Media

item.title: Australia's NEXTDC CEO to forgo fiscal 2027 bonuses after forecast cut, project delay
item.description: NEXTDC CEO Craig Scroggie will give up his fiscal 2027 bonus opportunities, the Australian data centre operator said on Monday, after it slashed its revenue forecast and paused future developments last week.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: NEXTDC (NXT.AX) CEO Craig Scroggie will give up his fiscal 2027 bonus opportunities, the Australian data centre operator said on Monday, after it slashed its revenue forecast and paused future developments [USN:L4N4661TS TEXT:"last week"]. Here are some details: The company said the board has withdrawn the resolution proposing an approval of grant of performance rights and restricted rights to the CEO under the fiscal 2027 long term incentive plan. Current Chairman Douglas Flynn has reaffirmed his intention to retire from the board once a new chairman is in place, after a short handover period. The board expects to appoint two new non-executive directors in the first calendar quarter of 2027, NEXTDC added. The company said the board has also withdrawn the resolution seeking shareholder approval to increase the maximum aggregate annual remuneration of non-executive directors by A$300,000 ($210,660), with the incumbent non-executive directors also agreeing to an immediate voluntary 10% reduction in their current fees. Last week, NEXTDC said delays to electricity network upgrades at one of its major Melbourne projects would mean about A$140 million worth of contracted customer revenue this financial year would be deferred. The firm is set to hold its annual general meeting on November 20. ($1 = 1.4241 Australian dollars)

item.title: ゼレンスキー氏「米の早期警告が完全再開」、弾道ミサイル防衛に不可欠
item.description: [キーウ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ ２５日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアの弾道ミサイル攻撃に関する米国からの早期警告について、最近生じていた問題が解消し、完全に再開されたと述べた。米国からの早期警告はウクライナの防空体制にとって不可欠となっている。

ウクライナのテレビ局ＴＳＮに対し、米スペースＸの軍事用衛星通信サービス「スターシールド」も２４日早朝から最高時速４２０キロでの移動中に利用できるようになったと説明した。米国がウクライナに外交圧力をかける中、１０月に入って利用が制限されていた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、オスロでウィットコフ米特使と会談した際に両問題について協議したとし、今回の変更を会談の成果と位置付けた。

１１月に予定されるウクライナ、ロシア、米国の実務者協議については、ウクライナ軍への制限や、戦後の中立化の強制は協議しないと述べた。

米国の仲介による自身とロシアのプーチン大統領を交えた３者会談の実現を改めて呼びかけた。

ゼレンスキー氏は以前から、戦争終結に向けた重要な決定や、ウクライナ領土の２割近くを占めるロシア占領地域の扱いといった核心的な問題について、ロシア側で実質的な協議ができるのはプーチン氏だけだと主張している。

「領土問題は譲れない一線であり、首脳レベルでのみ協議できる」と述べた。

item.title: Wizards, Hornets out to capitalize on early-season momentum
item.description: The Washington Wizards and host Charlotte Hornets have plenty of positives to build on heading into their meeting Monday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Washington Wizards and host Charlotte Hornets have plenty of positives to build on heading into their meeting Monday night. Both teams won Saturday, providing encouraging signs early in the season. Still, nothing has come easily for the Hornets in their first two home games. They lost by 47 points to Atlanta before watching a 23-point lead evaporate against Miami, then recovering to win 115-110. Brandon Miller led the way with 34 points against the Heat, matching the third-highest total of his four-year career. "Every game is not going to be perfect," Miller said. "Our mindset, other teams are going to go on runs and it's how we respond to it." The Wizards won their road opener 124-120 at Chicago on Saturday, with Trae Young scoring 25 points. Young will be a familiar opponent for Charlotte after making numerous appearances against the Hornets with the Atlanta Hawks. He has led Washington in scoring in each of the past two games after Anthony Davis poured in 34 points in the opener. "We were able to establish physicality," Wizards coach Brian Keefe said. "We stayed with it, and that was the part that was really great." Washington also likes what it has seen from Kyshawn George, particularly his ability to defend bigger players, according to Keefe. "That's why this team is so fun to coach because they want to put the time in," Keefe said. "Kyshawn is right at the top." No. 1 overall pick AJ Dybantsa has yet to make his Wizards debut while dealing with a left ankle injury. He will miss his fourth consecutive game Monday. Washington has shown depth, however, with 10 players seeing action against Chicago. In Saturday's victory, the Hornets benefited from late-game contributions by veteran newcomers Naz Reid and Grayson Allen. It was Charlotte's first home win of the season. "I think they're a big piece of what we're building here," Miller said. "Those are guys who have obviously been to the playoffs and been to places we want to be." Reid said he recognized how quickly the home crowd had embraced his play. Charlotte's veteran core will look to make an impact in close games as the season progresses. "We've been in enough of those situations in our past," Reid said. "Knowing how to keep our composure. ... Those are fun, especially with the home crowd." Hornets coach Charles Lee said the early-season games provide valuable opportunities to evaluate the team, adding that veteran Dennis Schroder has shown he can be a defensive presence. "Just really impressed with the whole group," Lee said. Miller has shot 29.7% from the field through three games after shooting nearly 43% for his career. "That's why you never overreact to shooting numbers or shooting slumps," Lee said. "That guy has a body of work that is just very impressive." The Hornets played their first three games without Kon Knueppel (hamstring), Coby White (calf) and Grant Williams (hamstring). Knueppel resumed individual on-court activity nearly a week ago, but no target date has been set for his return. Charlotte swept the four-game season series in 2025-26 after Washington won the previous five matchups. --Field Level Media

item.title: Real Madrid defeat Barcelona at Camp Nou to halve gap to LaLiga leaders
item.description: Real Madrid became the first side to beat Barcelona in LaLiga this season, defeating the league leaders 2-1 at Camp Nou with a brace from Kylian Mbappe.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: Real Madrid became the first side to beat Barcelona in LaLiga this season, defeating the league leaders 2-1 at Camp Nou with a brace from Kylian Mbappe. Mbappe's 11th goal in 10 LaLiga matches secured victory for Jose Mourinho in his return to El Clasico 13 years after his first spell at Real Madrid ended. Real halved the gap to league leaders Barcelona to three points. Both sides created a series of half-chances early on, but Real's forays forward came with far more resolve. Barca manager Hansi Flick's frustration on the touchline served as evidence that Mourinho's game plan was functioning better than his own. In the 41st minute, Yan Diomande crossed from the left and Gerard Martin's soft clearance hit the onrushing Mbappe, bouncing off him and into the net. Barcelona had the chance to level before the break after a fortunate ricochet, but Lamine Yamal couldn't convert from close range. It was a set piece that undid Real in the 61st minute, with Pedri's reverse pass finding Raphinha in space in the box and the Brazilian finishing into the corner. Real's swift movement of the ball in their own half continued to expose the Barcelona backline in the early stages of the second half. However, following the goal, the visitors found it increasingly hard to escape Barcelona's pressing. Barcelona's attacks were now finishing with last-ditch blocks from the Real defence, even if Mourinho's side continued to carry a threat going forward. That defensive conviction was rewarded with three minutes remaining. A loose touch from Barcelona substitute Gabriel Jesus set Real on the counter-attack, and substitute Eduardo Camavinga had enough pace to get in behind the defence, before squaring the ball for Mbappe to tap into the empty net. Barcelona remain top of the standings with 27 points from 10 games, one ahead of Atletico Madrid in second place. Third-place Real Madrid are on 24 points. Earlier Athletic Club beat Getafe 4-0 and Real Sociedad won 2-1 against Levante. Real Betis remain fourth after drawing 0-0 with Celta Vigo.

item.title: Lars Eller scores first goal as Panther in narrow win over Blackhawks
item.description: Lars Eller tallied the go-ahead goal with 2:23 remaining in the third period and Sandis Vilmanis and Matthew Tkachuk also scored to lift the visiting Florida Panthers to a 3-2 victory against the Chicago Blackhawks on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Lars Eller tallied the go-ahead goal with 2:23 remaining in the third period and Sandis Vilmanis and Matthew Tkachuk also scored to lift the visiting Florida Panthers to a 3-2 victory against the Chicago Blackhawks on Sunday. Panthers goaltender Akira Schmid stopped 20 shots as Florida snapped a two-game losing streak. Schmid turned aside Cole Smith on a breakaway with 5:45 to keep the game tied at 2. Eller netted his first goal of the season at 17:37 of the third period as the Panthers caught the Blackhawks in a line change. Eller took a long pass from Aaron Ekblad just inside the blue line, weaved down the right side and ripped a wrist shot from the circle past Chicago goaltender Spencer Knight. For the 37-old-year Eller, it was also his first goal as a member of the Florida Panthers. He started his NHL career with the St. Louis Blues in the 2009-10 season and has played for the Montreal Canadiens (2010-16), Washington Capitals (2016-23, 2024-25), Colorado Avalanche (2023), Pittsburgh Penguins (2023-25) and Ottawa Senators (2025-26). Special-teams struggles hurt the Blackhawks, who went 0-for-7 on the power play while also failing to capitalize on other chances at even strength. Knight made 29 saves. Chicago managed just six shots in the first period, but one of the club's early attempts provided a 1-0 lead. Ryan Greene tracked a puck that bounced at the top of the crease and into the air and batted it past Schmid and into the net. Andrew Mangiapane earned the primary assist in his return to the lineup; the forward had been out after suffering a lower-body injury in the club's season opener on Sept. 29. Florida tied the game just over four minutes later, as Vilmanis backhanded a loose puck past Knight after the backstop made a save on Sam Reinhart. The Panthers took a 2-1 lead on Matthew Tkachuk's power-play goal at 14:21. Tkachuk deflected Seth Jones' shot from the point just five seconds into the man advantage. Chicago netted the equalizer at 11:15 of the second period when Roman Kantserov took a Patrick Kane feed from behind the net and scored on a wrist shot from the right circle. Florida limited Chicago to one shot on goal during a four-minute power-play early in the second period after Carter Verhaeghe was whistled for a high-sticking double-minor against the Blackhawks' Wyatt Kaiser. Verhaeghe sent a wrist shot off the crossbar on a breakaway moments after springing from the penalty box. The Blackhawks fell to 2-4-0 on a seven-game homestand that is set to conclude with Tuesday's visit from the Los Angeles Kings. --Field Level Media

item.title: 仏抗議団体、さらなるデモ呼びかけ マクロン氏は難しい選択に直面
item.description:
Crispian Balmer Juliette Jabkhiro
[パリ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Crispian Balmer　Juliette Jabkhiro

[パリ ２５日 ロイター] - フランスの抗議団体と労働組合は２５日、政府への圧力を維持するため、さらなるデモを呼びかけた。２４日の全国規模のデモでは、大規模な警備態勢が混乱の抑制につながった。

内務省によると、２４日のデモ行進には４１万人が参加した。当局は警察官７万人を動員し、１７日に多くの都市で発生した略奪や破壊行為の再発を防ぐ一助となった。

労組幹部らは３１日の追加デモと１１月５日の全国ストライキを呼びかけた。賃金や生活費、公共サービスを巡る不満は、９月に始まった学生運動の枠を大きく超えて広がっていると指摘した。

左派の労組連合ソリデールのミュリエル・ギルベール共同代表はＢＦＭテレビに「さまざまな怒りが一つになりつつある」と述べ、学生や労働者、消防士などの不満が合流していると説明。「３１日に街頭に出るよう呼びかける」と語った。

教職員組合のＳＵＤエデュカシオンは１０月３１日のデモに参加すると表明。大手労組の労働総同盟（ＣＧＴ）は週内に参加の是非を決めるとした。

＜マクロン氏の対応余地は極めて限定的＞

２０１８年に燃料税への反発から生まれた草の根運動「黄色いベスト」も、市庁舎や国民議会（下院）の前での座り込みを含め、３１日の大規模な抗議行動を呼びかけた。

活動家のアゼルマ・シゴー氏は記者団に「この国には怒りがある。学校や大学、環状交差点、地域社会、農場、職場で、その怒りが膨らんでいる」と語った。

マクロン大統領は１９年には、黄色いベスト運動への対応として燃料費を引き下げる財源を確保することができた。

それから７年が経ち、財政が逼迫する中、マクロン氏には抗議参加者の要求に応じる余地はほとんどない。

政府は危機の収拾に向け、労組や学生代表との協議を始めたが、抗議活動の指導者らは、これまでに提示された措置は不十分だとしている。

item.title: Lula lidera apuração do 2º turno da eleição presidencial com 0,37% das seções eleitorais apuradas, diz TSE
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) liderava a apuração do segundo turno da eleição presidencial deste domingo com 55,53% dos votos válidos, enquanto o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) somava 44,47%, com 0,37% das seções eleitorais apuradas. mostraram dados do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) liderava a apuração do segundo turno da eleição presidencial deste domingo com 55,53% dos votos válidos, enquanto o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) somava 44,47%, com 0,37% das seções eleitorais apuradas. mostraram dados do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE). (Reportagem de Eduardo Simões; Edição de Alexandre Caverni)

item.title: ブラジル大統領選、開票を中断 最高裁が投票時間延長
item.description:
Ricardo Brito Brendan O'Boyle
[ブラジリア ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ricardo Brito　Brendan O'Boyle

[ブラジリア ２５日 ロイター] - ブラジル最高裁は２５日、大統領選決選投票の投票時間を２時間延長した。これを受け、選挙管理当局は既に初期段階の結果公表を開始していた開票作業を中断した。

決選投票は左派のルラ大統領と、有罪判決を受けたボルソナロ前大統領の長男で右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員の対決。

投票は当初、ブラジリア時間午後５時（日本時間２６日午前５時）に締め切られる予定だったが、午後７時まで延長された。バイア州の３都市で公共交通機関に問題が生じているとして延長を求めたルラ氏陣営の要請を最高裁が認めた。

最高裁の決定は午後５時の締め切りとほぼ同時に下された。その時点で選挙裁判所は既に開票結果の公表を始めており、開票率０．２５％の段階でルラ氏がボルソナロ氏をリードしていた。得票率はルラ氏が５７．６６％、ボルソナロ氏が４２．３４％だった。

最高裁の判断を受け、高等選挙裁判所（ＴＳＥ）は延長された投票時間が終了するまで開票作業を中断すると発表した。

ルラ氏は選管当局に対し、少なくとも９州で投票延長を要請していた。同氏の陣営は、一部当局者が投票日の公共交通機関の運行を減らし、有権者が投票所に行く妨げになったと主張した。

ルラ氏の地盤である北東部バイア州の裁判所はこれに先立ち、同州サルバドル市のバス車両数の削減を指示した疑いで市交通当局幹部の逮捕を命じた。

ボルソナロ氏も悪天候を理由に、少なくとも３州で投票を延長するよう求めていた。

item.title: North Korea tells UN South fabricated landmine incident, KCNA says
item.description: North Korea said it had written to the UN Security Council, accusing South Korea of fabricating a September landmine incident and endangering troops working to fortify the border, state media KCNA reported on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: North Korea said it had written to the UN Security Council, accusing South Korea of fabricating a September landmine incident and endangering troops working to fortify the border, state media KCNA reported on Monday. On Sunday, North Korea's UN representative said in a letter Seoul was using the landmine incident to depict Pyongyang's border construction as a military incursion, and warned violations of its sovereignty could trigger self-defence, according to KCNA. It concerns explosions on September 21 in the Demilitarised Zone between the two Koreas that seriously hurt two South Korean soldiers. Seoul subsequently said mines North Korea planted south of the Military Demarcation Line that runs through the DMZ caused the blasts. The UN Command said a North Korean mine across the line violated the armistice. Pyongyang has denied responsibility. North Korea's letter also accused South Korea of opening fire on North Korean personnel, calling it a violation of the UN Charter, which bars the threat or use of force against another state's territorial integrity. Seoul has said it gives warning broadcasts and fires warning shots to make North Korean soldiers return north when they cross the MDL. North Korean troops have been building tactical roads and fences and laying mines near the MDL in recent years. Last Friday, South Korea's defence ministry again [USN:L1N46905T TEXT:"proposed"] military talks with North Korea to reduce the risk of accidental clashes.

item.title: Bulls searching for shooting aim entering clash vs. Celtics
item.description: The Chicago Bulls are still looking for ways to improve their 3-point shooting, an issue that has carried over from the offseason into the early stages of the season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Chicago Bulls are still looking for ways to improve their 3-point shooting, an issue that has carried over from the offseason into the early stages of the season. Entering Monday night's road game against the Boston Celtics, the Bulls ranked 17th among the 30 NBA teams in 3-point percentage during the 2025-26 regular season but sit last in the league through three games this season at 22.6%. Chicago is averaging 9.3 made 3-pointers on 41.3 attempts per game. "I want them to shoot the ball," Chicago coach Tiago Splitter said following Saturday's 124-120 loss to Washington. "They can shoot. Part of their development is you are open, you got to shoot it. You practice every day; you have to take them in the game. Sometimes it's the shot the other team is giving to you. It's a team thing, not just one player. Everybody's got to be better. We don't have a 7-3 guy that's going to clean up the whole thing. So it's got to be a team effort and awareness." The Bulls went 12-for-43 from 3-point range against the Wizards. Caleb Wilson, the fourth pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, scored a game-high 30 points but went 1-for-9 from beyond the arc. Jalen Smith and Matas Buzelis each went 2-for-7. "We all knew coming into season (3-point shooting was) one of things we've got to get better and develop," Splitter said. "Caleb one of nine, Matas two of seven - those are the guys who are going to take shots. They are going to get better. But shoot (28) percent, you've really got to win the possession game to win when you are not shooting the ball well." Chicago has struggled defensively as well, allowing 128.0 points per game. Only Milwaukee (129.0) has allowed more. Boston bounced back from a season-opening 121-113 loss at Detroit by beating New York 107-103 at home Friday night. Jayson Tatum scored a game-high 36 points and grabbed nine rebounds in the win. The Celtics also received strong performances from center Neemias Queta and guard/forward Jordan Walsh. Queta started at center for Boston last season but now comes off the bench after the Celtics acquired Mitchell Robinson in the offseason. Queta had 15 points, six rebounds and three blocked shots in 22 minutes against the Knicks. Walsh, known primarily for his defense, has started both of Boston's games. He helped limit New York's Jalen Brunson to 19 points on 7-of-17 shooting. Walsh, who signed a three-year, $15 million extension last summer, was assigned to guard Cade Cunningham in Boston's opener. "I thought he was special (against New York)," Boston's Paul George said. "He set the tone. Jalen is a handful, and for a young guy he can be a lot. Jordan took the challenge. He did a great job of navigating being physical and not being overly physical. He gave him some good looks defensively to frustrate him and get him out of rhythm." Boston has won nine of the past 11 meetings. --Field Level MediaThe Chicago Bulls are still looking for ways to improve their 3-point shooting, an issue that has carried over from the offseason into the early stages of the season. item.title: ノーベル平和賞マチャド氏、ベネズエラ帰国 約1年ぶり
item.description:
Vivian Sequera Sarah Kinosian Keren Torres
[カラカス／バルキシメト ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Vivian Sequera　Sarah Kinosian　Keren Torres

[カラカス／バルキシメト ２５日 ロイター] - ベネズエラの野党指導者でノーベル平和賞受賞者のマリア・コリナ・マチャド氏が２５日、約１年ぶりに帰国した。これまで何度か帰国を試みたものの実現していなかった。

マチャド氏はＸに「私はここにいる。皆さんと共に」と投稿した。

広報担当者が公開した画像によると、同氏は西部ララ州の教会に姿を見せた。ロイター記者によれば、居合わせた人々は国歌を歌って出迎え、同氏が車で去る際には「自由を」と叫んだ。陸路で首都カラカスに向かうという。

帰国に向けた取り組みはトランプ政権との関係を試すものとなった。マチャド氏は米政権が１月にマドゥロ大統領を拘束する以前から、同政権を味方に引き入れようと関係構築に努めていた。

ロイターが６月に報じたところによると、米政府はマチャド氏に帰国を遅らせるよう少なくとも１回要請しており、同氏はこれまで何度か入国を試みたものの実現しなかった。同氏のチームは今回、どのように帰国したか詳細を明らかにしていない。

トランプ氏は、マドゥロ氏の下で副大統領を務めたロドリゲス暫定大統領への支持を繰り返し表明。米企業によるベネズエラでの石油生産や他の事業に関する合意を称賛してきた。９月には、同国で民主的な選挙を検討するのは時期尚早だと述べた。

トランプ氏は２５日、ホワイトハウスで、マチャド氏の帰国については何も知らないと述べ、米国が引き続きロドリゲス氏を支持することを示唆した。

マチャド氏について「彼女はとても素敵な女性だ」としつつ、「だが、われわれはベネズエラで非常にうまくやっている」と語った。

事情に詳しい関係者２人によると、マチャド氏はパナマからプライベート機でコロンビアに移動し、その後、陸路でベネズエラに入った。

ルビオ米国務長官は声明で「マチャド氏の安全な帰国を可能にした環境は、米国が支援する和解協議の直接的な成果だ。この協議によって既に数百人の政治犯が釈放され、亡命していた野党関係者数百人が帰国した」と表明。

「全ての政治勢力がこの協議を支持することを期待する。ベネズエラにとって、自由で公正な選挙だけでなく、持続的な民主主義を平和的に実現する上で、過去３０年間で最良の機会だ」と述べた。

マチャド氏はマドゥロ政権によって出国を禁じられていたが、１年以上にわたりほぼ身を隠して生活した後、ノーベル平和賞授賞式に合わせて２０２５年末に秘密裏に出国していた。

item.title: NFL roundup: Falcons harass 49ers into first loss of 2026
item.description: Michael Penix Jr. threw for three touchdowns and the Atlanta Falcons' defense forced four turnovers as they claimed a 29-20 victory on Sunday afternoon to hand the visiting San Francisco 49ers their first loss.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Michael Penix Jr. threw for three touchdowns and the Atlanta Falcons' defense forced four turnovers as they claimed a 29-20 victory on Sunday afternoon to hand the visiting San Francisco 49ers their first loss. Penix completed 25 of 34 passes for 213 yards while rookie linebacker Kendal Daniels picked off a pass and recovered a fumble in the fourth quarter for the Falcons (3-4), who won their first home game of the season. Nick Folk added three field goals. Brock Purdy hit 27 of 40 passes for 288 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions for the 49ers (6-1). Christian McCaffrey rushed for 39 yards and one touchdown while catching six passes for 61 yards. The 49ers built a 14-3 lead on Kaelon Black's 30-yard touchdown run on the first play of the second quarter, but the Falcons responded with 23 unanswered points as Penix completed touchdown strikes to Nick Muse, Kyle Pitts Sr. and Drake London. Giants 27, Titans 21 (OT) Devin Singletary ran for a 30-yard touchdown to defeat his former team and propel New York to the walkoff victory over host Houston. J.J. McCarthy completed 20 of 28 passes for 252 yards to win his debut start for the Giants (4-2-1) and his fifth consecutive start overall. Cam Skattebo had 17 carries for 124 yards, including a 42-yard run the play before Singletary's game-winner, and Malik Nabers caught seven passes for 111 yards. C.J. Stroud completed 17 of 28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns for the Texans (2-5), who dropped to 0-4 at home. Woody Marks had 19 carries for 66 yards and tight end Dalton Schultz had five catches for 45 yards. Stroud's 3-yard touchdown pass to Xavier Hutchinson with 52 seconds left forced overtime. Steelers 16, Saints 10 Aaron Rodgers broke a tie with Peyton Manning on the all-time touchdown passes list, Jaylen Warren rushed for 101 yards and Pittsburgh defeated New Orleans in the first NFL game played in Paris. The Steelers (5-2) won their third straight game after shutting out the Saints (2-5) in the second half in Stade de France in Saint-Denis, just north of Paris. Rodgers broke a tie with Manning for third place on the all-time list when he completed his 540th career touchdown pass to Darnell Washington in the second quarter. Tyler Shough passed for 278 yards with a touchdown and an interception for the Saints, who rushed for just 18 yards -- 130 fewer than Pittsburgh. Browns 27, Titans 24 Cleveland kicker Andre Szmyt made up for an earlier miss by nailing the game-winner from 32 yards on the final play of a victory over Tennessee in Nashville. After Tennessee tied it 24-24 with 58 seconds remaining on Tony Pollard's third touchdown of the day, Deshaun Watson hit Harold Fannin Jr. for 36 yards with 28 seconds left. Szmyt, who missed from 43 yards in the fourth quarter, booted the winner to keep the Browns (5-2) atop the AFC North. Watson eclipsed 300 yards for the first time with the Browns as he completed 25 of 36 passes for 308 yards and an interception. He also rushed for a score. For the Titans (1-6), Pollard carried 25 times for 129 yards. Dolphins 28, Jets 25 Malik Willis threw two touchdown passes to rookie Caleb Douglas and ran for another to help Miami pick up its first win, beating New York in East Rutherford, N.J. Willis completed 14 of 21 passes for 208 yards without an interception and rushed for 37 yards on eight attempts to help give head coach Jeff Hafley his first NFL victory. Ollie Gordon II ran for 103 yards and a touchdown on 25 carries as the Dolphins (1-5) rushed for 156 yards overall. The Jets (2-5) lost for the fifth time in six games and lost their eighth consecutive game against an AFC East opponent. Geno Smith completed 23 of 30 passes for 287 yards, three touchdowns and one interception. Smith's third touchdown pass was a 12-yarder to Mason Taylor, who caught five passes for 62 yards and two touchdowns. Buccaneers 43, Panthers 13 Bucky Irving rushed for 106 yards and two touchdowns, Calijah Kancey returned a fumble 32 yards for a touchdown and Tampa Bay blasted mistake-prone Carolina in Charlotte. Baker Mayfield was back at quarterback for the Buccaneers (2-5) after missing three games with a dislocated right thumb and had an easy return while completing 7 of 11 passes for 64 yards and one touchdown. The Panthers (3-3) committed four turnovers and missed an extra-point kick. Bryce Young was 14-of-27 passing for 163 yards with two interceptions and a touchdown, while losing a fumble. Vikings 16, Colts 10 Kyler Murray passed for 150 yards and a touchdown, and safety Harrison Smith made an interception in the final minutes to preserve a Minnesota victory over Indianapolis in Minneapolis. T.J. Hockenson had the go-ahead touchdown catch for the Vikings (6-0) early in the fourth quarter. Jordan Mason had a team-high 68 rushing yards, and Justin Jefferson caught four passes for 44 yards on seven targets. Will Reichard made three of four field goal attempts. Jonathan Taylor rushed for 95 yards and a touchdown to lead the Colts (2-5). Daniel Jones completed 13 of 22 yards for 108 yards and an interception. Indianapolis fell despite converting 9-of-16 third- and fourth-down chances. Bengals 35, Ravens 13 Joe Burrow threw four second-half touchdown passes and Cincinnati scored 35 unanswered points to record a victory over host Baltimore. Burrow completed 16 of 18 passes for 249 yards while leading five touchdown drives in the half as the Bengals (4-2) overcame a 13-0 halftime deficit. Tee Higgins caught six passes for 148 yards and a touchdown. Ja'Marr Chase, Mike Gesicki and Drew Sample also caught touchdown passes and Samaje Perine rushed for a score. Lamar Jackson (ankle) missed his third straight game for the Ravens (4-3). Tyler "Snoop" Huntley completed 23 of 34 passes for a career-high 298 yards with one touchdown and one interception. Zay Flowers had eight catches for 137 yards and one score for Baltimore, which blew a double-digit lead for the second straight week. Broncos 30, Cardinals 16 Bo Nix threw a touchdown pass and ran 62 yards for another, J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey also scored TDs, and Denver topped Arizona in Glendale, Ariz. Nix finished 15-for-29 passing for 222 yards and also rushed for 73 yards for the Broncos (5-2), who have won three in a row and won three of four games against NFC West opponents. Jacoby Brissett finished 27-for-48 passing for 272 yards and a touchdown pass to Trey McBride, who had 10 receptions for 111 yards for the Cardinals. Arizona (2-5) has lost 10 straight home games dating back to Sept. 14, 2025. Rams 35, Raiders 21 Matthew Stafford threw for three touchdowns and visiting Los Angeles built a 28-3 second-quarter lead on its way to victory against slumping Las Vegas. Stafford completed 23 of 29 passes for 195 yards and an interception as the Rams (3-4) snapped a two-game losing streak. Kyren Williams (16 rushes, 99 yards) and Blake Corum (17 attempts, 93 yards) each scored a touchdown and contributed to Los Angeles' 386 yards of offense. Kirk Cousins hit 26 of 44 throws for 295 yards and two touchdowns, but it wasn't enough as the Raiders (3-4) dropped their fourth straight game. Las Vegas managed just 48 yards on 17 carries and abandoned the run for most of the second half. Lions 20, Packers 17 Jake Bates kicked a 22-yard field goal as time expired to give host Detroit a victory over Green Bay and snap the Packers' three-game winning streak. The Lions' Jared Goff passed for 303 yards and two touchdowns, both to Jameson Williams. Amon-Ra St. Brown caught nine passes for 153 yards and Williams hauled in five for 91 yards. Jahmyr Gibbs rushed for 116 yards on 29 carries for Detroit (4-2). Jordan Love passed for 274 yards, two touchdowns and one interception for Green Bay (4-3). Running back Josh Jacobs, activated off the NFL commissioner's exempt list, rushed for 36 yards and caught five passes for 55 yards and a touchdown in his season debut. --Field Level Media --Field Level Media

item.title: Panthers OT Taylor Moton suffers fractured fibula in loss to Bucs
item.description: Carolina Panthers veteran right tackle Taylor Moton was carted off the field with a fractured left fibula during Sunday's 43-13 home loss to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Carolina Panthers veteran right tackle Taylor Moton was carted off the field with a fractured left fibula during Sunday's 43-13 home loss to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Panthers coach Dave Canales acknowledged that Moton would be "out for a while" after the contest. It was just Moton's second game since returning from a serious blood clot issue. He was hurt when teammate Rasheed Walker, the left tackle, fell across the back of his legs in the opening minute of the third quarter. Moton held his left leg and punched the turf while waiting for trainers to come on the field. "It was the fibula. There is a fracture there," Canales told reporters. "We'll have to get the full run-up to be able to give you the extent of the whole thing. "But it was just sick for ‘T-Mo.' Working his way back, getting out there. Just kinda an end-of-the-play thing, guys just rolled up on him unexpectedly at that moment." Moton, 32, was diagnosed with blood clots in June and was placed on blood thinners. He began the season on the reserve/non-football injury list and was activated ahead of last week's game against the Philadelphia Eagles. "I feel for T-Mo so much, such a great human being, such a great guy," quarterback Bryce Young said. "He's as resilient as they come. He's going to do everything he can; he's going to work, and he'll bounce back from it, but, yeah, just from the human side, I feel for him." Sunday marked the 130th NFL start (in 147 career games) for Moton, a second-round draft choice in 2017 out of Western Michigan. Monroe Freeling, the team's 2026 first-round draft pick who started the first four games in place of Moten, finished the game at right tackle. Freeling played at Georgia. --Field Level Media

item.title: Antonelli gana en EEUU, pero tendrá que esperar a México para proclamarse campeón de F1
item.description: Kimi Antonelli ganó el domingo el Gran Premio de Estados Unidos con Mercedes, lo que le sitúa a un paso de convertirse en el campeón más joven de la historia de la Fórmula 1 el próximo fin de semana en México.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kimi Antonelli ganó el domingo el Gran Premio de Estados Unidos con Mercedes, lo que le sitúa a un paso de convertirse en el campeón más joven de la historia de la Fórmula 1 el próximo fin de semana en México. El italiano de 20 años hizo todo lo posible por poner el campeonato fuera del alcance de sus rivales en Texas, pero Lewis Hamilton, de Ferrari, y su compañero de equipo en Mercedes, George Russell, hicieron lo justo para retrasar lo inevitable al quedar cuarto y octavo, respectivamente. Antonelli solo necesita ahora sumar dos puntos, un noveno puesto, en México para asegurarse el título. Charles Leclerc, de Ferrari, terminó segundo, a 13,078 segundos, en la carrera del domingo en el Circuito de las Américas de Austin, mientras que Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, quedó tercero, ayudado por un coche de seguridad virtual en los últimos compases que frenó a un Hamilton que le pisaba los talones y que terminó un segundo más tarde. La contundente victoria desde la largada, con una estrategia de una sola parada, fue la novena de Antonelli esta temporada, y ahora aventaja a Russell en 123 puntos y a Hamilton en 124, cuando quedan un máximo de 125 puntos por ganar, cifra que se reducirá a 100 tras la carrera de México. "Era el resultado que necesitábamos y todo el equipo se lo merece muchísimo", dijo Antonelli. "Sé que estamos muy cerca. Intentamos terminar por todo lo alto y esperamos poder sentenciar el título muy pronto". El vigente campeón de McLaren, Lando Norris, terminó quinto, mientras que Isack Hadjar, de Red Bull, fue sexto, por delante de Oscar Piastri, de McLaren. Liam Lawson fue noveno con Racing Bulls y Pierre Gasly se llevó el último punto para Alpine. Antonelli realizó una salida fulgurante y llegó a tener una ventaja de 2,3 segundos al final de la primera vuelta, mientras que los dos pilotos de Ferrari se enzarzaron en una lucha por el segundo puesto con Verstappen, que había tenido una salida lenta. Leclerc se adelantó, antes de que el Red Bull le volviera a pasar, y estuvo a punto de chocar con Hamilton tras un embotellamiento. El coche de seguridad virtual se activó brevemente en la segunda vuelta para permitir a los comisarios retirar los restos del asfalto, y a Russell se le impuso una penalización de cinco segundos por obtener ventaja sobre Piastri en la primera vuelta, en la curva 13. "Yo estaba por el interior, él adelantaba por el exterior, ese es su riesgo", dijo Russell por radio antes de la sanción. Ollie Bearman, de Haas, también recibió una penalización de 10 segundos por provocar una colisión con Gasly y se retiró a mitad de carrera.

item.title: Antonelli wins US Grand Prix but must wait for title
item.description: Kimi Antonelli won the US Grand Prix for Mercedes on Sunday to stand on the brink of becoming Formula One's youngest ever champion in Mexico next weekend.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kimi Antonelli delivered a dominant US Grand Prix victory for Mercedes on Sunday to stand on the brink of becoming Formula One's youngest ever champion with four rounds to spare in Mexico next weekend. The 20-year-old Italian did all he could to put the championship out of reach of his rivals in Texas but Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Mercedes teammate George Russell did just enough to delay the inevitable with fourth and eighth respectively. Antonelli now needs to score only two points -- a ninth place -- in Mexico City to be sure of the title even if Russell wins. "It was the result we needed and the whole team deserve it so much," he said of his first win since Spain last month. "I know we're very close. We try to finish on a high and hopefully we can clinch it very soon". LECLERC SECOND AND VERSTAPPEN THIRD Ferrari's Charles Leclerc finished second, 13.078 seconds behind, in Sunday's race at Austin's Circuit of the Americas with Red Bull's Max Verstappen third and helped by a late virtual safety car that slowed a chasing Hamilton who finished one second down the road. The win from pole position on a one-stop strategy was Antonelli's ninth in of the season and he now leads Russell by 123 points, and Hamilton by 124 with a maximum 125 remaining to be won and that reducing to 100 after Mexico. "The main headline is that for me (it is) the best race he's delivered so far," said Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff. "The race of a champion who isn't the champion yet, but exceptional". McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris finished fifth on a one stop strategy after being passed by both Verstappen and Leclerc on lap 47 of 56 with his tyres struggling. Red Bull's Isack Hadjar was sixth, and ahead of McLaren's Oscar Piastri. Liam Lawson was ninth for Racing Bulls and Pierre Gasly took the final point for Alpine. Antonelli made a flying getaway and was 2.3 seconds clear at the end of the opening lap while the Ferrari pair took the fight to slow-starting Verstappen for second place. Leclerc went ahead, before being passed again by the Red Bull, and nearly made contact with Hamilton after the uphill scramble off the grid. The virtual safety car was briefly deployed on lap two to allow marshals to clear debris and Russell, who had started sixth, had to serve a five second penalty at his sole stop after stewards ruled he had gained an advantage on Piastri on the opening lap at Turn 13. Russell was then unable to find a way past the McLaren. "Six good laps, 50 bad laps," he said of his race. "I want to understand why the pace was so bad on the first stint. The penalty was a bit ridiculous as well, but that's the least of my worries after such a bad weekend. "For me, as long as we're in the constructors' (lead), that's the main thing. Obviously I'd like to finish best of the rest, but P2, P3, P5 is not champion, so it doesn't mean anything." Haas's Ollie Bearman also collected a 10 second penalty for causing a collision with Gasly and retired at the half-distance.

item.title: La expansión de BYD en Corea desafía el dominio de Hyundai en su propio terreno
item.description: Los datos de Bloomberg Intelligence muestran que las ventas de vehículos eléctricos e híbridos de BYD se multiplicaron por nueve entre enero y agosto, hasta alcanzar casi las 18 000 unidades.
item.dc:creator: Hyonhee Shin, Andy Lin
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Cuando Lee Seongdong decidió cambiar su Chevrolet Spark de 2016 en abril, la espera de dos años para adquirir el Casper Electric de Hyundai Motor Co. ya le estaba inclinando hacia el Dolphin de BYD Co. Quedó tan impresionado por este vehículo, dotado de numerosas prestaciones, que firmó el contrato en el acto. El precio también resultaba atractivo: el Dolphin con carrocería hatchback tiene un precio de partida de 24,5 millones de wones (18 500 dólares), aunque, gracias a los descuentos, Lee pagó menos de 23 millones de wones —una cifra similar a la del Casper Electric subvencionado, que se puede adquirir por unos 22 millones de wones en Seúl, pero solo en su versión más básica—. A esto se suma el hecho de no tener que esperar más tiempo que el servicio militar obligatorio de Corea del Sur para recibir el vehículo, por lo que este youtuber de 47 años afirmó que el BYD era “demasiado bueno como para dejarlo pasar”. La compra de Lee forma parte de un cambio en auge que se está produciendo a medida que BYD lleva su estrategia de bajo coste —que ya le está permitiendo ganar cuota de mercado en Europa— a los compradores surcoreanos, cada vez más sensibles al precio. Los datos de Bloomberg Intelligence muestran que las ventas de vehículos eléctricos e híbridos de BYD se multiplicaron por nueve entre enero y agosto, hasta alcanzar casi las 18 000 unidades, mientras que las ventas comparables de Hyundai cayeron un 6 %, hasta situarse en unas 139 000. Este impulso se prolongó hasta septiembre, cuando las matriculaciones de BYD alcanzaron las 20 000 —el doble de su objetivo inicial para el año—, según datos de la Asociación Coreana del Automóvil y la Movilidad. El rápido ascenso de BYD significa que ha superado a Volvo y a Toyota Motor Corp. en la clasificación de fabricantes de automóviles extranjeros en Corea, un hito significativo si se tiene en cuenta que no entró en el mercado de turismos hasta principios de 2025 y que, en julio, perdió el acceso a las subvenciones gubernamentales tras no cumplir algunos requisitos. Esto supone un riesgo creciente para los gigantes locales Hyundai Motor Co. y Kia Corp., que, a pesar de seguir ostentando una cuota combinada del 72 % del mercado nacional, tienen dificultades para competir con los modelos más económicos y centrados en la tecnología que ofrece BYD. Por primera vez desde 2010 —excluyendo la caída provocada por la pandemia en 2020—, es probable que las ventas globales anuales de Hyundai caigan por debajo de los 4 millones de unidades, sin alcanzar su objetivo de 4,16 millones, según la analista de Samsung Securities Co., Esther Yim. “El principal factor de su desaceleración es la competencia china”, escribió Yim en una nota reciente. “La agresiva campaña de exportación de los fabricantes chinos de vehículos eléctricos ha desencadenado intensas guerras de precios en todas partes, excepto en EE. UU. y la India, y Hyundai y Kia están obteniendo resultados por debajo de lo esperado en todos esos mercados”. Los fabricantes de automóviles chinos están acelerando su expansión en Corea. BYD está ampliando su gama con el Sealion 6 DM-i, un híbrido enchufable que cuesta 37,5 millones de wones, el más barato de su segmento. Zeekr, la marca de gama alta de Geely Automobile Holdings Ltd., comenzó la semana pasada a entregar su SUV eléctrico 7X tras superar las 1.500 reservas, mientras que XPeng Inc. y Chery Automobile Co. han establecido filiales locales antes de su entrada en el mercado. Esta rápida expansión está inquietando a los directivos de Hyundai. En un acto celebrado este mes, Lee Jae-kyu, vicepresidente sénior encargado del desarrollo de vehículos en Hyundai Motor Group, afirmó que sentía “desesperanza” ante la ventaja en diseño y precios que mostraron los fabricantes de automóviles chinos en el reciente Salón del Automóvil de París. “Mientras que los fabricantes de automóviles europeos presentaron diseños y tecnología poco inspiradores, los vehículos chinos ofrecían un diseño superior a precios aproximadamente 10 000 dólares más baratos”, señaló Lee. “No podía quitarme de la cabeza la idea de que las empresas europeas acabarán hundiéndose pronto, y que incluso nuestro grupo está estructurado de tal manera que, con el tiempo, podría ser absorbido por China”. A pesar del rápido crecimiento de BYD, los analistas señalan que las marcas chinas se enfrentan a obstáculos a largo plazo debido a una escasa infraestructura de servicio, elevados costes de reparación, primas de seguro elevadas y una rápida depreciación. En las comunidades de conductores en línea, los propietarios de vehículos BYD se quejan con frecuencia de los retrasos en el suministro de recambios y de las elevadas facturas de reparación, llegando en algunos casos a superar los 11 millones de wones por pequeños choques en el parachoques o los guardabarros. BYD tiene previsto ampliar sus puntos de servicio en Corea del Sur de 20 a 26 a finales de este año. La estrategia de precios bajos de esta empresa con sede en Shenzhen se pondrá a prueba, en última instancia, frente a la red de más de 1.200 centros de servicio nacionales de Hyundai y Kia, según Brian Lee, de CLSA Securities Korea Ltd. “En estos momentos, todo el mundo se centra exclusivamente en el precio de venta”, afirmó. “Pero a medida que el mercado madure y queden claros el valor de reventa, el acceso al servicio y los costes de mantenimiento, su atractivo general podría desvanecerse”. No obstante, la expansión en nuevos mercados extranjeros resulta fundamental para los fabricantes de automóviles chinos, ya que se enfrentan a una ralentización de la demanda en el mercado nacional, a barreras cada vez mayores en Europa y a una exclusión efectiva del mercado estadounidense. Por el contrario, Corea impone un arancel de importación de tan solo el 8 % a los turismos chinos y, en agosto, excluyó a los vehículos eléctricos de un proyecto de ley que concedía desgravaciones fiscales a los fabricantes nacionales, lo que deja a Hyundai y Kia con pocas protecciones normativas frente a las importaciones chinas baratas. El mes pasado, la KAMA —que representa a los cinco fabricantes de automóviles de Corea del Sur, entre los que también se incluyen GM Korea, Renault Korea y KG Mobility— instó al Parlamento a aprobar incentivos fiscales y medidas de apoyo. “La penetración de los vehículos eléctricos chinos podría provocar el colapso no solo de los fabricantes nacionales de vehículos eléctricos, sino de toda la industria automovilística”, advirtió el grupo en un comunicado. La creciente preocupación por el rápido avance de China ha llevado a los legisladores surcoreanos a presentar este mes un proyecto de ley bipartidista que propone desgravaciones fiscales que cubran hasta el 50 % de los costes anuales de producción nacional para sectores estratégicos, incluidos los vehículos eléctricos. Para compradores como Lee, el propietario del Dolphin, las preocupaciones generales sobre las políticas reflejan lo que él observa en el mercado: las marcas chinas están elevando el listón de la competencia. “Espero que nuestra industria automovilística nacional tenga éxito, pero, al fin y al cabo, hay que ganar mediante la competencia en un mercado abierto”, afirmó Lee. “Todo el mundo debe mantenerse alerta y competir”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Brazil pauses presidential vote count after Supreme Court extends voting hours
item.description: The election pits leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva against right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, the son of convicted former President Jair Bolsonaro.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Brazil pauses presidential vote count after Supreme Court extends voting hours

The election pits leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva against right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, the son of convicted former President Jair Bolsonaro.

Supporters of Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, the Workers' Party (PT) candidate for re-election, gather outside a polling station after the arrival of Brazil's presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro of the Liberal Party (PL) to cast his vote during the presidential runoff election, in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, Oct 25, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Agustin Marcarian)

BRASILIA: Brazil's Supreme Court extended voting in the country's presidential election by two hours on Sunday (Oct 25), leading the electoral authority to pause a vote count that had already started publishing early-stage results. The election pits leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva against right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, the son of convicted former President Jair Bolsonaro. Polls were initially set to close at 5pm Brasilia time (4am Monday, Singapore time) and will now close at 7pm after Supreme Justice Cristiano Zanin accepted a request by Lula's campaign to extend voting, pointing to public transportation issues in three cities in the state of Bahia. Zanin's decision landed right around the 5pm cutoff, when the electoral court had already started publishing results that showed Lula leading Bolsonaro with 0.25 per cent of ballot counted. Lula had 57.66 per cent of votes, compared with 42.34 per cent for Bolsonaro, the early count showed.

After the Zanin ruling, the TSE said it would pause the vote count to allow for the extended voting window to close.

Related:

Meta tells Brazil court it treats Lula and Bolsonaro campaigns equally

Lula and Bolsonaro spar in Brazil poll debate

PAUSE ADDS UNCERTAINTY The pause over the vote count injects uncertainty into a Brazilian electoral process still grappling with the fallout from 2022, when Jair Bolsonaro refused to concede defeat to Lula. His supporters later invaded government buildings in protests against the result, and Bolsonaro received a 27-year prison sentence for plotting a coup. Lula had asked electoral authorities to extend voting in at least nine states after his campaign alleged some officials reduced election day public transportation, impacting voters' ability to get to the polls. Earlier on Sunday, a court in Bahia, a Lula stronghold in the Northeast, ordered the arrest of a top transportation official in the city of Salvador over allegations that he directed a reduction in the city’s bus fleet. Bolsonaro had also asked for voting to be extended in at least three states, citing bad weather.

item.title: Voting opens in New Zealand for November 7 election with no clear frontrunner
item.description: Voting opened in New Zealand on Monday for the November 7 general election, with ballot boxes available for nearly two weeks at shopping centres, transport hubs and community halls, ahead of what is expected to be a closely contested race.
item.dc:creator: Lucy Craymer
item.content:encoded: Voting opened in New Zealand on Monday for the November 7 general election, with ballot boxes available for nearly two weeks at shopping centres, transport hubs and community halls, ahead of what is expected to be a closely contested race. The Electoral Commission said 207 voting places were open on Monday, with that number rising to more than 2,300 on election day. Overseas voting [USN:L6N46707J TEXT:"opened"] earlier, on October 21. The race remains [USN:L6N45R12T TEXT:"too close"] to call. Public polling has swung sharply in recent days, underscoring the absence of a clear frontrunner under New Zealand's [USN:L6N43N091 TEXT:"mixed-member proportional"] system, where coalition deals are often needed to form a government. A 1News-Verian poll published on October 20 put the ruling centre-right National Party at 32% and opposition Labour at 27%, while a Post/Freshwater Strategy poll published a day earlier had Labour narrowly ahead on 28.7% to National's 27.6%. In both surveys, the smaller Opportunity party was polling around or above the 5% threshold needed to enter parliament, making it a [USN:L6N44H07U TEXT:"potential kingmaker"]. The start of voting comes just hours after enrolment closed at midnight on Sunday, a deadline that has become one of the campaign's most contentious issues. Unlike in previous elections, voters can no longer enrol or update their details during the voting period, meaning people not enrolled by the cutoff cannot cast a vote in this election. Critics say the earlier cutoff could deter participation, particularly among groups that are harder to reach. The Human Rights Commission said last year that ending election-day enrolment was likely to unjustifiably restrict participation and would disproportionately affect underrepresented groups. As of October 21, 3,729,667 people were enrolled to vote, already above the final 2023 total of 3,688,292, when the enrolment rate was 94.7%, according to the Electoral Commission.

FAST

KYIV: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said US warnings about imminent Russian ballistic missile strikes , critical to Ukraine's air defences, had been fully restored after recent issues. Speaking to Ukraine's TSN television channel, he said SpaceX's Starshield satellite internet had been working at speeds of up to 420kmh since early on Saturday (Oct 24) morning, after it had been throttled earlier in October amid diplomatic pressure on Kyiv from Washington. Zelenskyy said he discussed both issues in a meeting with US special envoy Steve Witkoff in Oslo, casting the changes as results of that meeting. Speaking about the upcoming technical talks between Kyiv, Moscow and Washington in November, Zelenskyy said Ukraine would not discuss limits to its armed forces, or enforced post-war neutrality. Kyiv has long sought entry into the NATO alliance despite the reticence of some members. Zelenskyy also renewed his push for a trilateral US-brokered meeting between him and Vladimir Putin. The Ukrainian leader has long argued Putin is the only person in Russia who can make major decisions to end the war or meaningfully discuss core issues, such as the fate of the nearly 20 per cent of Ukraine that Russia occupies. "The issue of territories is a red line that can be discussed exclusively at the level of leaders," Zelenskyy said.
